findings.issue: Same SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF secret for dev and prod — no separate Supabase project per environment
findings.impact: Migrations applied from develop branch directly target the same database as main branch migrations
findings.fix: Create separate Supabase projects for dev and prod; add separate secret names

findings.issue: Prod Caddyfile only has /health route for health checks; dev Caddyfile has /healthz and /health* with API subdomain
findings.impact: Health check routing differs between environments — deployment validation may succeed in dev but fail in prod
findings.fix: Standardize health endpoints: add /healthz and /health* handle_path to prod Caddyfile

findings.issue: SMTP/email env vars not configured in any deployment workflow — SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS and EMAIL_FROM all missing
findings.impact: Password reset and transactional emails non-functional in both dev and prod environments
findings.fix: Add SMTP configuration secrets to all deploy workflows; validate at deploy time

findings.issue: No backup/restore procedure documented for production — Supabase PITR is the only recovery option but undocumented
findings.impact: Production data recovery during incident requires guessing procedures; no documented RTO/RPO
findings.fix: Create docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md with PITR procedure, storage backup, and DR runbook

findings.issue: Default droplet size s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb known to OOM — documented in AGENTS.md but not updated in Terraform
findings.impact: New dev droplets provision at undersized spec; OOM under normal load
findings.fix: Update default droplet_size to s-2vcpu-2gb in variables.tf

findings.issue: Production version badge build-args not passed — NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME omitted
findings.impact: Production always shows 'v0.0.0-dev' and 'local'; cannot identify deployed version from badge
findings.fix: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.run_number }}, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME to web Docker build

findings.issue: Dev API subdomain (chat-api.mainecybertech.us) deployed but unused — DNS + Caddy block exist but nothing consumes it
findings.impact: Wasted TLS cert, DNS record, and Caddy config; all API traffic goes through same-domain /v1/* proxy
findings.fix: Remove unused API subdomain DNS record for development; document as future option

findings.issue: No external uptime monitoring for production — only Docker HEALTHCHECK and deploy-time validation
findings.impact: Production downtime detected only when users report it or email alerts trigger for CPU/memory
findings.fix: Add free-tier uptime monitoring (UptimeRobot or Better Uptime) checking /healthz every 5 minutes

findings.issue: Production deploy workflow has no staging environment or canary step — deploys directly to production droplet with zero traffic splitting or rollback capability
findings.impact: Any bad deploy immediately affects all production users. No gradual rollout, no health check before full traffic cutover. Rollback requires a second deploy.
findings.fix: Add a blue/green deployment strategy or at minimum: (1) deploy to staging compose, (2) health check, (3) swap Caddy upstream to new containers, (4) hold old containers for rollback window

findings.issue: Production deploy uses ssh-keyscan with no strict host key checking — `StrictHostKeyChecking=no` accepts any host key
findings.impact: Man-in-the-middle attack on SSH deploy connections. The deploy script connects to the production droplet without verifying its host key.
findings.fix: Add known_hosts entry for the production droplet IP/hostname. Use StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new as minimum.

findings.issue: Production compose uses `image: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/api:latest` tag — ':latest' is mutable and can be overwritten by a failed build
findings.impact: A partially built or broken image can replace the ':latest' tag, breaking future rollouts. No way to know which exact SHA is running in production.
findings.fix: Use immutable tags: SHA-based (api:sha-abc123) or build-number-based. Update deploy workflow to reference the specific tag.

findings.issue: Production deploy workflow uses `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` secrets for Terraform remote state — these are also used in infra-development.yml which provisions the infrastructure
findings.impact: Secrets are shared across workflows with no scoping. The production deploy workflow doesn't need Terraform state access — it deploys code, not infra.
findings.fix: Remove Terraform state secrets from deploy-production.yml. Use separate read-only deploy tokens if infra state lookup is needed.

findings.issue: Production web service has no CPU/memory resource limits set — a memory leak in Next.js can OOM the entire droplet
findings.impact: No resource isolation between services. A single runaway container can crash all services on the droplet.
findings.fix: Add deploy.resources.limits block to each service in docker-compose.prod.yml (api: 512MB RAM, web: 512MB RAM, worker: 256MB RAM)

findings.issue: Production compose mounts /var/run/docker.sock for the caddy service with read-write access — Caddy can manage Docker containers
findings.impact: If Caddy is compromised, the attacker has full Docker control. Caddy only needs TLS cert persistence, not Docker socket access.
findings.fix: Remove docker socket mount. Caddy TLS certs should be stored in a named volume instead.

findings.issue: Dev deploy workflow has `--force-recreate` flag but no `--pull always` — containers use the local cached image even if a newer version exists in GHCR
findings.impact: Deploy may use stale images if the build step was skipped or failed. Not pulling means the running image can diverge from the registry.
findings.fix: Add `--pull always` to docker compose up in deploy-development.yml

findings.issue: Production deploy runbook is incomplete — it documents steps 1-3 (build, transfer, compose up) but has no section for rollback, no section for monitoring the deploy, no section for verifying the deploy succeeded
findings.impact: Operators following the runbook during an incident will have incomplete guidance. Missing critical out-of-band steps.
findings.fix: Add rollback procedure, post-deploy verification checklist, and monitoring dashboard links to the runbook.

findings.issue: Message list renders all messages as flat DOM — no virtualization, no inverted scroll, no scroll anchoring
findings.impact: Channels with 1000+ messages freeze browser; users cannot load older messages via infinite scroll; scroll position lost on new messages
findings.fix: Implement @tanstack/react-virtual with inverted scroll, scroll anchoring via IntersectionObserver, cursor-based pagination

findings.issue: No worker for notification fanout — notification creation and push delivery happen synchronously in the API request thread
findings.impact: Sending a message that @mentions 50 users blocks the API response for 50 push notification attempts; request latency scales linearly with mention count
findings.fix: Move notification creation and push delivery to background worker (apps/worker/) using Redis-backed job queue (BullMQ)

findings.issue: No caching layer for frequently accessed data (workspace list, channel list, user profiles) — every page load queries Supabase
findings.impact: Every navigation triggers a Supabase query; no read-through cache for chat-loading patterns
findings.fix: Add Redis cache for workspace/channel list and user profiles with 60s TTL; implement cache invalidation on mutations

findings.issue: Socket.io configured without Redis adapter for multi-instance deployments — only works with single API server
findings.impact: Cannot horizontally scale API server; WebSocket state is per-process; messages from one instance not broadcast to sockets on another
findings.fix: Implement Socket.io Redis adapter for cross-instance event broadcasting; configure Redis pub/sub channels

findings.issue: No global command palette (Ctrl+K) — users must navigate via sidebar for every context switch
findings.impact: Power users cannot quickly search and navigate to channels, users, or settings via keyboard
findings.fix: Implement Ctrl+K command palette with fuzzy search across channels, recent DMs, users, settings; keyboard-navigable

findings.issue: TypeScript types severely out of sync with DB schema — 6 interfaces defined vs 16 tables
findings.impact: Developers forced to use 'any'; no type safety; schema changes require manual type updates
findings.fix: Regenerate types via supabase gen types typescript; add CI check for drift; create shared types package

findings.issue: All 9 pages use 'use client' — no React Server Components; no route-level code splitting
findings.impact: Full JS bundle downloaded on every navigation; no streaming SSR; slow initial load on all pages
findings.fix: Convert landing, workspace list to server components; use next/dynamic for ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage

findings.issue: No response caching middleware — identical requests (e.g., workspace list) re-query Supabase on every request
findings.impact: Unnecessary DB load on read-heavy endpoints; no stale-while-revalidate pattern
findings.fix: Implement response cache middleware with in-memory cache and configurable TTL per route pattern

findings.issue: No loading.tsx in route groups — no Suspense fallback for page transitions
findings.impact: Page transitions show blank screen or nothing while data loads
findings.fix: Add loading.tsx with Skeleton components to each route group: (workspace), (auth)

findings.issue: No empty state components for workspace list, channel list, message list, search results
findings.impact: When data is empty, users see blank panels with no guidance on next action
findings.fix: Create reusable EmptyState component; add to workspace list ('Create your first workspace'), channel list ('No channels yet'), search ('No results found')

findings.issue: No page metadata (title/description) on any of 7 page.tsx files - all pages use the root layout's generic 'Chat Platform' title
findings.impact: All pages share the same browser tab title. No SEO value for any page. Screen readers announce the same title on every navigation. Missing dynamic titles (e.g. workspace name, channel name) hurts usability for users with many tabs.
findings.fix: Since all pages are 'use client', implement dynamic title via document.title in useEffect for workspace and channel pages

findings.issue: Full Redis-backed response cache middleware (145 lines) exists but is never imported or applied to any route - completely dead code
findings.impact: No API response caching anywhere. Identical requests (e.g. workspace list, channel list for the same user) hit the database every time. Wasted compute and DB load.
findings.fix: Apply responseCache middleware to read-only GET endpoints: workspaces, channels, members, profiles, feature-flags

findings.issue: channel_role_overrides table created in migration with RLS policies and middleware support, but has no CRUD API endpoints - cannot be managed from UI
findings.impact: The entire RBAC channel override system is non-functional. Users cannot set per-channel role overrides despite the infrastructure being fully built.
findings.fix: Add CRUD API endpoints for channel_role_overrides with requireAdmin middleware

findings.issue: Soft-delete functions exist in migrations (soft_delete_workspace, etc.) but API services always call .delete() directly - permanent hard delete, no recovery
findings.impact: Deleted workspaces, channels, and messages cannot be recovered. No trash/recycle bin feature. Users have no undo option for accidental deletions.
findings.fix: Call soft_delete_workspace RPC instead of .delete() for workspaces, channels, and messages. Add restore endpoints.

findings.issue: requireChannelAccess and requireMessageAccess middleware execute 3-4 sequential DB queries per request (channel lookup, membership check, deny-override, private-channel check)
findings.impact: Every protected API call incurs 3-4 database roundtrips before reaching the route handler. This N+1 pattern adds ~20-40ms latency to every request.
findings.fix: Consolidate into a single SQL query or RPC that returns all checks in one roundtrip

findings.issue: No reusable EmptyState component - message list, channel list, workspace list, and search results all implement empty states inline with different styling
findings.impact: Inconsistent empty states across the app. Changes to empty state design require updating 4+ separate locations. Divergent UX patterns.
findings.fix: Create shared EmptyState component in packages/ui with icon, title, description, and action props. Migrate inline implementations.

findings.issue: WorkspaceList and ChannelList are ~80% duplicated (same List + fetch + skeleton + Link pattern). CreateWorkspaceDialog and CreateChannelDialog are ~70% duplicated.
findings.impact: Changes to one list or dialog must be manually replicated to the other. Increased maintenance burden and risk of behavioral divergence.
findings.fix: Abstract shared list pattern into a generic ResourceList component with configurable fetch/filter/render. Abstract dialog pattern into a generic CreateResourceDialog.

findings.issue: Legacy migration file 20260625000007_add_missing_indexes.sql is superseded by 20260627000001_add_missing_indexes.sql but still present
findings.impact: Dead migration file creates confusion about which indexes are active. Both files define indexes, but only the later one should exist.
findings.fix: Remove the superseded migration file after verifying no Prod migration chain depends on it

findings.issue: No chaos testing scripts or tooling exist — zero failure injection capability
findings.impact: System has never been tested under failure conditions; brittle assumptions about degraded behavior are unvalidated
findings.fix: Implement Tier 1 failure tests using unit-level mocking (DB timeout, socket failure, webhook 500) in existing service tests

findings.issue: No E2E test for database unavailable scenario — API should return 503, client should show 'connection lost' state
findings.impact: User-facing degraded state never validated — users may see confusing errors or blank screens
findings.fix: Use Playwright route interception to simulate API 503; verify correct degraded UI is shown

findings.issue: No test for socket disconnect/reconnect behavior — client message queuing and replay on reconnect untested
findings.impact: Messages written during disconnect period may be silently lost
findings.fix: Write integration test: disconnect socket client, send message via API, reconnect, verify message received via socket

findings.issue: Circuit breaker (opossum) is a dependency but has zero test coverage
findings.impact: Circuit breaker logic — open, half-open, recovery — never tested; unexpected behavior in production
findings.fix: Write unit tests for circuit breaker: simulate 50%+ failures, verify open state; simulate recovery, verify half-open

findings.issue: Webhook retry logic, DLQ, and exponential backoff have zero integration test coverage
findings.impact: Retry mechanism may silently fail; DLQ may not capture failed deliveries; backoff may misbehave under load
findings.fix: Write tests: mock webhook endpoint returning 500, verify retry count increments, verify DLQ capture after max retries

findings.issue: No test for rate limiter being hit — client should show 'too many requests' with retry-after header
findings.impact: Rate limiting UX never validated — users may see unhelpful errors or silent failures
findings.fix: Write E2E test: burst requests beyond rate limit, verify 429 status and Retry-After header, verify correct client message

findings.issue: No test for Redis unavailability (for Socket.io adapter) — fallback to in-memory mode untested
findings.impact: If Redis fails, Socket.io may fail entirely or exhibit undefined behavior
findings.fix: Write integration test: start server without Redis, verify Socket.io falls back to in-memory adapter, verify messaging still works

findings.issue: No test for file upload failure (image processing error, oversized file, invalid type)
findings.impact: Upload error UX never validated — users may see confusing errors or hang state
findings.fix: Write E2E test with oversized file, invalid content type, and simulated processing failure; verify appropriate error messages

findings.issue: No test for webhook delivery timeout — circuit breaker open, DLQ capture, and operator notification
findings.impact: Timeout behavior never validated; circuit breaker may not open as expected
findings.fix: Write integration test: mock slow webhook endpoint (>10s), verify timeout, verify circuit breaker opens, verify DLQ capture

findings.issue: No synthetic endpoint for triggering controlled failures (e.g., /debug/fail-webhooks, /debug/slow-db)
findings.impact: Chaos testing requires modifying production services — no safe test harness
findings.fix: Add debug endpoints (guarded by NODE_ENV) for triggering controlled failures in test environments

findings.issue: Stale socket tokens persist indefinitely with no token refresh mechanism — socket disconnects only on manual page refresh
findings.impact: When a user's Supabase session token expires (e.g., after 1 hour), the Socket.io connection remains open with the stale token. No token refresh reconnection logic exists. The server cannot proactively disconnect expired sessions. Users appear 'connected' after token expiry but get auth errors on next message send.
findings.fix: Add socket token refresh middleware that checks auth token expiry on each channel:join. Implement client-side 403 handling: on 'connect_error' or 403 event, refresh the Supabase session and reconnect with new token. Emit 'session:expired' from server on expired token detection.

findings.issue: Query timeout wrapper exists (createQueryTimeout) but is never imported or used in any route or service
findings.impact: The entire query timeout infrastructure is dead code. Any slow query (unindexed search, full table scan, deadlock) will hang the API process indefinitely, consuming a connection pool slot and eventually exhausting available connections.
findings.fix: Apply createQueryTimeout to all Supabase query chains: `.rpc('search_messages', ...)`, message listing, user search, notification queries. Set timeouts of 5-10s for user-facing queries and 30s for background operations.

findings.issue: Message send failure catches error but provides no retry mechanism — user input is lost on failure
findings.impact: If the WebSocket or REST message send fails (network blip, server error, auth timeout), the error is caught but the message text is cleared from the input field. User's composed message is lost with no retry button, undo, or draft recovery mechanism.
findings.fix: Keep the message text in the input on failure and show an inline error banner with 'Retry' button. Add optimistic message with 'failed' status that allows tap-to-retry. Store draft in localStorage as fallback.

findings.issue: Feature flags exist for notifications and media but no kill switch exists for core message send or WebSocket functionality
findings.impact: If a deployment causes a message persistence failure or socket storm, operators cannot disable message sending or WebSocket connections via feature flags. The only mitigation is full rollback or manual container restart.
findings.fix: Add feature flags: 'messages.disable_send' (returns 503 on POST /messages), 'socket.disable_new_connections' (returns 503 on upgrade request), 'reactions.disable' (returns 503 on reaction mutations). Document the kill switch procedure in the incident response runbook.

findings.issue: Thread capability: parent_id exists in messages table (FK to self) but no thread metadata, participant tracking, reply count, or unread count
findings.impact: Threaded conversations require schema expansion: thread_metadata table, thread_participants table, thread_last_read tracking
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Add thread_metadata (reply_count, participant_count, last_activity_at), thread_participants, thread_last_read tables

findings.issue: Notifications: basic CRUD + push exists, but NO @mention parsing, @role/@everyone, channel muting, or notification preferences
findings.impact: Mention system is greenfield; notification engine needs rewrite for mention routing
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Add mention parsing pipeline, mention validation against membership, notification preference model per user

findings.issue: Virtualization: NO virtual list, NO inverted scroll, NO windowing — all messages rendered as flat DOM
findings.impact: Channels with 1000+ messages cause OOM; no infinite scroll capability
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Must implement from scratch with @tanstack/react-virtual, inverted scroll, cursor pagination

findings.issue: Rich text editor: plain textarea with NO markdown preview, NO @mention autocomplete, NO emoji picker, NO drag-drop
findings.impact: Message input needs complete rewrite for rich editing
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Must enhance textarea with mention autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop upload, markdown preview

findings.issue: RBAC: owner/admin/member roles exist but NO channel-level overrides, NO custom roles, NO hidden channel support
findings.impact: Granular RBAC requires schema + middleware + RLS redesign
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Add channel_role_overrides table, update middleware for override resolution, design RLS for hidden channels

findings.issue: Search: full-text search exists with search_messages RPC but NO date range filter, NO file metadata search, NO relevance ranking
findings.impact: Search is functional but basic — lacks enterprise search capabilities
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Add ts_rank for relevance scoring, date range filter, file metadata indexing

findings.issue: Incoming webhooks: NONE exist — only outgoing webhook delivery pipeline
findings.impact: External systems cannot post to channels; greenfield feature
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Design incoming webhook model with channel ownership, secret generation, payload formatting, rate limiting

findings.issue: Optimistic UI: NO optimistic state system — all mutations wait for API response
findings.impact: UI feels slow; no instant-feedback pattern
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Create optimistic state management with temporary IDs, rollback on failure, server-echo deduplication

findings.issue: Multi-theme: light/dark only — NO slate dark, OLED high-contrast, or multi-theme architecture
findings.impact: Theme engine needs expansion for 4 named themes with SSR-safe hydration
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Expand CSS token system; implement SSR-safe theme hydration; add Slate Dark and OLED themes

findings.issue: Audio/video media: NO WebRTC, NO media server, NO signaling channel, NO media grid — greenfield
findings.impact: Audio/video is last priority in roadmap but requires new infrastructure
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Phase 3: evaluate LiveKit; design signaling; implement media grid

findings.issue: 11 unresolved P0 issues across feature domains prevent release — threads (2), mentions (2), virtualization (1), editor (1), RBAC (1), webhooks (1), media (2), platform (1)
findings.impact: Feature expansion cannot ship with active P0 issues — each represents a blocking security, data loss, or functionality risk
findings.fix: Resolve all P0 issues before release. Priority order: RBAC (permission bypass), mentions (notification loss), threads (data model), virtualization (OOM), editor (broken input), webhooks (missing endpoint), media (infrastructure)

findings.issue: Feature expansion requires 8+ new database tables with no rollback scripts — compounds existing migration risk
findings.impact: Schema rollout for new features is irreversible without PITR; production migration failure means data loss
findings.fix: Write down scripts for all new migrations before deployment; test rollback in CI; implement forward-fix migration pattern for hotfix scenarios

findings.issue: No feature flag wiring exists — every new feature would be globally on or off with no gradual rollout capability
findings.impact: Cannot dark-launch, canary-test, or phased-rollout any feature; bugs affect all users simultaneously
findings.fix: Wire feature flag evaluation before shipping features: threads_flag, mentions_flag, rbac_flag, webhooks_flag, search_v2_flag, editor_flag. Set all to false by default, enable per-workspace for testing.

findings.issue: Frontend/backend contract mismatch risk is high — no shared types package, no API contract validation, realtime event names ad-hoc
findings.impact: Contract drift between frontend and backend will cause silent production errors for new features
findings.fix: Create shared API contract definitions (packages/contract/) before implementing features; validate with tRPC or Zod-to-JSON-Schema

findings.issue: Zero E2E coverage for all 11 features — no automated flow testing for any new capability
findings.impact: Feature regressions will reach production without detection; release confidence is extremely low
findings.fix: Set E2E coverage requirement: each feature must have at least 1 happy-path E2E test before release (minimum 11 new E2E tests)

findings.issue: No post-release monitoring checklist — no KPIs defined for feature health (adoption, error rate, latency)
findings.impact: Cannot detect if feature rollout causes issues without proactive monitoring
findings.fix: Define feature-level monitoring for each feature: adoption rate, error rate, latency p95. Add dashboard panels. Configure Sentry alerts for error spikes.

findings.issue: No phased release plan — all features would ship simultaneously in a single deployment
findings.impact: Coordination risk; if one feature has issues, all features must rollback together
findings.fix: Plan phased release: Phase 1 (feature flags, test infra, RBAC), Phase 2 (threads, mentions, search), Phase 3 (editor, virtualization, optimistic UI), Phase 4 (webhooks, themes, responsive), Phase 5 (media)

findings.issue: No rollback runbook for feature-specific rollback — feature flag disable is only option; if schema change is involved, feature cannot be rolled back independently
findings.impact: Feature rollback requires full deployment rollback if schema migration was applied
findings.fix: Design feature-level rollback: feature flag kill-switch as first line, forward-fix migration as second line, PITR as last resort. Document for each feature.

findings.issue: Zero E2E test execution for any feature flow — all 30+ tests skipped
findings.impact: No automated confidence in cross-feature workflows; manual regression testing only.
findings.fix: Set up local Supabase E2E project; unskip critical-path tests; require 1 happy-path E2E per feature before merge.

findings.issue: Notification fanout, webhook delivery retry, mention processing run synchronously or as fire-and-forget with no retry/DLQ
findings.impact: Async delivery failures silently drop notifications/webhooks; no retry for transient failures; no delivery observability.
findings.fix: Implement BullMQ job queue for notification fanout, webhook delivery, mention processing with exponential backoff and DLQ.

findings.issue: Feature flags exist in DB/service layer but are not wired into feature boundaries — no dark-launch or gradual rollout capability
findings.impact: All features deploy globally at once; no kill-switch; cannot canary-test or phased-rollout.
findings.fix: Wire featureFlagService.evaluateFlag() into each feature boundary before shipping; set all new flags disabled by default; enable per-workspace for testing.

findings.issue: No performance baselines for feature-level operations — search, message send, WebSocket connect unmeasured
findings.impact: Feature performance regressions undetected; no capacity planning data.
findings.fix: Define feature KPIs (message send p95 < 500ms, search p95 < 1s); add k6 scenarios with CI regression thresholds.

findings.issue: No down/rollback scripts for any of 24+ applied migrations
findings.impact: Feature migrations irreversible without PITR; forward-fix only option.
findings.fix: Write down scripts for future feature migrations; document forward-fix pattern for production hotfixes.

findings.issue: No post-release monitoring checklist — no feature-level KPIs, dashboards, or Sentry alerts
findings.impact: Rollout issues undetected until users report them.
findings.fix: Define feature KPIs (adoption rate, error rate, latency p95); add Grafana dashboard panels; configure Sentry alerts for >1% error spikes.

findings.issue: Realtime event payloads for threads/mentions have no typing — ad-hoc emit() calls with untyped objects
findings.impact: Frontend must manually track event payloads; event name typos cause silent failures.
findings.fix: Create typed event registry in packages/realtime/ with event name constants and payload interfaces.

findings.issue: No feature-specific rollback runbook — only full deployment rollback option
findings.impact: Single problematic feature forces rollback of all features.
findings.fix: Document 3-tier rollback: flag disable -> forward-fix migration -> PITR; document per feature.

findings.issue: Zero test coverage for all 11 planned features — threads, mentions, RBAC, webhooks, search, virtualization, optimistic UI, editor, themes, responsive layout, media UI all untested
findings.impact: Feature expansion will ship 11 new feature areas with zero automated regression coverage
findings.fix: Write test matrix per feature: unit tests (service logic), integration tests (API contracts), E2E tests (user journeys), and performance tests. Prioritize threads, mentions, RBAC, and webhooks first.

findings.issue: No test data factories or seeding infrastructure — tests must set up workspace, channels, messages, and members from scratch
findings.impact: E2E tests for feature scenarios require complex multi-step setup; tests are skipped because setup is too hard
findings.fix: Create test data factory functions (buildWorkspace(), buildChannel(), buildMessage(), buildUser()) with sensible defaults; add Playwright fixtures for auth context

findings.issue: No performance or load tests for any feature area — search, virtualization, and realtime fanout untested under load
findings.impact: Feature performance regressions go undetected; search latency and virtual list scroll FPS degrade silently
findings.fix: Add k6 scenarios for search throughput, message send latency, and WebSocket connect rate; add browser performance benchmarks for virtual list scroll FPS and DOM node count

findings.issue: No CI execution tiers for feature tests — all E2E tests run in single pipeline, no smoke/full/regression separation
findings.impact: E2E test suite will become slow as feature tests are added, blocking CI
findings.fix: Implement 3-tier CI strategy: Tier 0 (smoke, <2min, on every push), Tier 1 (critical path, <10min, on PR), Tier 2 (full suite, on nightly/release)

findings.issue: No visual regression tooling for new frontend features — themes, responsive layout, rich editor cannot be visually diffed
findings.impact: UI regressions in 5 new frontend feature areas will reach production undetected
findings.fix: Install Playwright visual comparison snapshots; add screenshot baselines for theme variations, responsive breakpoints, and editor states

findings.issue: No flaky test prevention strategy — no retry logic, no test isolation, no cleanup hooks
findings.impact: Flaky tests from complex async feature interactions will undermine CI reliability
findings.fix: Implement Playwright test retries (retries: 2), beforeEach cleanup for DB state, test isolation for WebSocket connections, dedicated test Supabase project

findings.issue: No Storybook for isolated component testing of new UI features
findings.impact: Editor, media grid, and theme components cannot be developed and tested in isolation
findings.fix: Install Storybook with @chat/ui package; create stories for all new feature components with theme and responsive viewport variants

findings.issue: All 30+ E2E test scenarios are test.skip('Requires Supabase test project setup') — zero E2E execution for threads, mentions, notifications, RBAC, webhooks, search, media
findings.impact: Feature regressions in UI interactions cannot be caught before release; no confidence in cross-feature workflows.
findings.fix: Set up test Supabase project or mock local Supabase; unskip critical-path E2E tests; add Playwright project for Supabase-local E2E in CI.

findings.issue: k6 load tests only exercise GET /healthz — no load scenarios for message send, search, WebSocket connections, or notification fanout
findings.impact: Performance regressions in search, message throughput, realtime event fanout go undetected; no capacity planning data.
findings.fix: Add k6 scenarios: message send throughput, search query latency, WebSocket connect rate (100 concurrent); set p95 thresholds.

findings.issue: No test coverage for search_messages RPC — date ranges, author filters, channel scoping, and edge cases all untested
findings.impact: Search query breakages silently reach production; RPC signature changes or permission changes undetected.
findings.fix: Add service tests for search: basic text search, date range, author filter, channel filter, empty query, special characters, XSS.

findings.issue: No test data factory functions — every test manually creates workspace, channel, members, messages with raw Supabase inserts
findings.impact: 30+ lines of setup per test discourages test creation; shared state leads to flakiness.
findings.fix: Create test factories (buildUser, buildWorkspace, buildChannel, buildMessage) in packages/db/test-utils/ with sensible defaults and auth fixtures.

findings.issue: Webhook payload processing has no size validation before parsing — an attacker can send a multi-GB JSON payload that exhausts API server memory
findings.impact: Unbounded webhook payload parsing is a trivial denial-of-service vector. API can be OOM-killed by any authenticated user with webhook access.
findings.fix: Add payload size check before JSON.parse (max 1MB). Return 413 Payload Too Large if exceeded.

findings.issue: Message editing has no optimistic locking — two concurrent PATCH requests can overwrite each other without detecting the conflict. The `updated_at` timestamp is the only version field but it's never checked in the WHERE clause.
findings.impact: Lost update problem: if Alice edits a message while Bob also edits the same message, one edit silently overwrites the other. No version/etag checking.
findings.fix: Add a `version` column (integer) to messages table. PATCH must include version, WHERE clause checks it, increment on success. Return 409 Conflict if stale.

findings.issue: Same optimistic locking gap exists for channel PATCH — no version check, concurrent updates can silently overwrite
findings.impact: Same lost update vulnerability as messages.
findings.fix: Add version column to channels table with same conflict detection pattern.

findings.issue: getSupabase() creates a new Supabase client on every call with no connection pooling or reuse — the client object is stateless but instantiation overhead and configuration is repeated
findings.impact: Each call to getSupabase() creates a fresh client. While the underlying Supabase client uses HTTP keep-alive, the wrapping and retry configuration is duplicated. Minor performance concern that becomes significant under load.
findings.fix: Create supabase client once at module level (singleton pattern). getSupabase() just returns the singleton.

findings.issue: Socket.io rate limiting is per-server in-memory (Map) — does not work across multiple API instances behind a load balancer
findings.impact: With horizontal scaling, rate limits reset per instance. A client can make 10x the intended connections by distributing across instances.
findings.fix: Move Socket.io rate limiting to Redis or use the same Redis adapter for rate limit state.

findings.issue: Webhook delivery (POST /webhooks/:id/deliver) has no timeout — if the target server hangs, the API handler hangs indefinitely holding a connection
findings.impact: A single hanging webhook delivery can exhaust the API's connection pool, cascading to all other requests.
findings.fix: Add fetch timeout (e.g. 10s via AbortController) to webhook delivery HTTP requests.

findings.issue: Auth, channels, webhooks, notifications, consent modules emit zero business metrics (counters, histograms, gauges). Only the general middleware (rate-limit, request-id) has been instrumented with Prometheus via the metrics lib.
findings.impact: No visibility into auth success/failure rates, channel creation rates, webhook delivery latency, notification delivery rates. Business observability is blind.
findings.fix: Add Prometheus counters/histograms to each module's key operations following the pattern in lib/metrics.ts

findings.issue: All notification endpoints (GET /notifications, PATCH /notifications/:id/read, POST /notifications/read-all) lack explicit authorization middleware — they rely on req.supabase RLS but have no route-level access control
findings.impact: While RLS provides database-level protection, the lack of route-level middleware is inconsistent with other modules and may mask auth gaps if RLS policies are incorrect.
findings.fix: Add requireAuth middleware to all notification routes for defense-in-depth consistency.

findings.issue: Consent routes (POST /consent, GET /consent, GET /consent/preferences) have no authorization middleware — they assume req.userId is always set
findings.impact: If the authenticate middleware fails silently (no session), req.userId is undefined. Consent operations would fail with opaque errors.
findings.fix: Add requireAuth middleware to consent routes for consistency with other modules.

findings.issue: Architecture docs reference the old cloud-init context (port 3000 vs 80 with Caddy) but are not fully updated to reflect the current reverse-proxy topology documented in AGENTS.md

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut help documentation — users cannot discover keyboard shortcuts
findings.impact: Productivity features go unused
findings.fix: Add keyboard shortcut reference in settings; add Ctrl+/ help overlay

findings.issue: Feature-flags service uses admin client (service_role key) for ALL operations — no RLS, no user context, no audit trail. Every feature flag read/write bypasses auth entirely.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user or service that can access the feature-flags API can read/modify ALL flags without restriction. No tenant isolation.
findings.fix: Replace admin client with req.supabase user client for reads. Restrict write operations to admin-only middleware. Add RLS policies for feature_flags table.

findings.issue: getProfiles() SELECT * includes email column — user email addresses exposed via profile search API to all authenticated users
findings.impact: PII (email addresses) leaked through profile search. The hardening fix removed email from workspace member list but this separate code path still exposes it.
findings.fix: Remove email from getProfiles() SELECT. Return only id, display_name, avatar_url.

findings.issue: Auth routes (POST /auth/login, POST /auth/register, POST /auth/verify) do not enforce rate limiting — no middleware attached
findings.impact: Attacker can brute-force login attempts or register accounts programmatically without throttle. No rate-limit middleware applied to auth endpoints unlike other route groups.
findings.fix: Apply rate-limit middleware to auth routes, possibly with a stricter limit (e.g. 5 req/min per IP for login)

findings.issue: JWT_SECRET is loaded into memory as a plain string with no constraint on minimum length or cryptographic strength
findings.impact: A weak or short JWT_SECRET could allow forged auth tokens. No validation occurs at startup.
findings.fix: Add validation requiring JWT_SECRET >= 32 characters. Consider using asymmetric signing (RS256) instead of HS256.

findings.issue: CORS is configured with origin: '*' in development — allows any website to make cross-origin requests to the API
findings.impact: While SameSite=Strict cookies provide some protection, a permissive CORS policy weakens the CSRF defense and allows data exfiltration via fetch requests from attacker-controlled origins.
findings.fix: Restrict CORS origin to the specific dev domain (localhost:3000) or use a dynamic allowlist

findings.issue: Auth routes have no try/catch blocks — all errors propagate to Express default error handler which may leak internal details in 500 responses
findings.impact: Errors in auth flow may expose stack traces or database error messages to the client.
findings.fix: Wrap all handler bodies in try/catch with structured error responses

findings.issue: Only workspaces module has a service test file (workspace.service.test.ts). All other 9 modules (auth, channels, messages, reactions, webhooks, notifications, consent, push, feature-flags) have zero service-layer tests.
findings.impact: 90% of API business logic has no automated test coverage. Regression detection is minimal.
findings.fix: Add at minimum smoke tests for each module's service layer

findings.issue: Auth module has zero logging — no logger calls anywhere. Unlike workspaces/channels modules which use structured logger, auth failures are invisible in production
findings.impact: Authentication failures, rate-limit hits, and suspicious activity in auth flow are not logged. Security incident detection is impaired.
findings.fix: Add structured logger.warn/info calls to auth routes for login attempts, failures, and suspicious patterns

findings.issue: 5 stub prompt files in docs/prompts/ (self_heal.md, rollback_strategy.md, backup_restore_strategy.md, test_strategy.md, k6_load_test_strategy.md) contain only placeholder content
findings.impact: Core operational strategies (rollback, backup/restore, self-healing, load testing) are undocumented.
findings.fix: Replace stubs with actual strategy documents based on current infrastructure

findings.issue: The 18 docs/runbooks/ files are comprehensive but no single INDEX.md or QUICKREF.md exists — operators must browse the directory to find the right runbook
findings.impact: Low discoverability during incidents when every second counts.
findings.fix: Create an INDEX.md at docs/runbooks/ with one-line descriptions and category groupings

findings.issue: Feature-flag routes reference requireWorkspaceMembership('workspaceId') but no :workspaceId param exists in route path — every request returns 400
findings.impact: Feature flags completely non-functional; all workspace feature-flag operations silently fail
findings.fix: Remove requireWorkspaceMembership or add workspaceId as a body/query parameter

findings.issue: API env schema uses EMAIL_FROM while shared packages/config/env-schema.ts uses SMTP_FROM — same purpose, different env var names
findings.impact: Operators may set SMTP_FROM expecting it to be read, but API reads EMAIL_FROM and falls back silently
findings.fix: Standardize on a single name (EMAIL_FROM), update shared schema to match

findings.issue: Web env schema missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME — all used in code but not validated
findings.impact: Version badge shows '0.0.0-dev' and 'local' in production; Sentry not configured on frontend
findings.fix: Add missing vars to apps/web/lib/env.ts Zod schema

findings.issue: Terraform state key is hardcoded with no environment interpolation — same state key for dev and prod
findings.impact: Parallel dev and prod Terraform operations corrupt each other's state
findings.fix: Use ${var.environment} in state key to isolate environments

findings.issue: Runbook references packages/db/sql/migrations/ directory which no longer exists — all migrations consolidated under supabase/migrations/
findings.impact: Operators following runbook will look in wrong directory for migration files
findings.fix: Update runbook to reference supabase/migrations/ as the single source of migrations

findings.issue: Duplicate policy file sets exist: docs/hardening_super_bundle/policies/ and docs/audits/policies/ — risk of drift
findings.impact: Policy changes may be applied to one set but not the other; inconsistent gating
findings.fix: Consolidate to single source of truth (hardening/policies/) and remove duplicates

findings.issue: Migration sequence gap in 20260626 batch — jumps from 01 to 22 suggesting deleted or renumbered migrations
findings.impact: Potential confusion about migration history; Supabase CLI tracking may conflict
findings.fix: Audit migration sequence; renumber or add placeholder files to fill gaps

findings.issue: Webhook GET route reads workspace_id from query param but middleware checks req.params.workspaceId — they never match
findings.impact: Webhook listing bypasses workspace membership check via query param
findings.fix: Create middleware that reads from req.query.workspace_id instead of req.params

findings.issue: Production Caddyfile missing API subdomain block for chat-api.mainecybertech.com — DNS record exists but Caddy does not serve it
findings.impact: Wasted DNS record; direct API subdomain access gets no response
findings.fix: Remove unused DNS record or add Caddy site block for completeness

findings.issue: Default droplet size still s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb despite known OOM issues — AGENTS.md documents upgrade to s-2vcpu-2gb
findings.impact: New dev droplets provisioned with undersized spec will experience OOM
findings.fix: Update default droplet_size to s-2vcpu-2gb in terraform variables.tf

findings.issue: Stale index (2).md file found in dashboard directory — appears to be a duplicate from a copy conflict
findings.impact: Git tracking noise; confusing for maintainers
findings.fix: Remove duplicate index (2).md file

findings.issue: Critical prompt files (final_reconciliation_repo_audit_prompt.md, final_reconciliation_principal_audit_prompt.md, final_full_repo_deep_dive_quality_confirmation_prompt.md) are stubs containing 'Replace this placeholder' - not usable for execution
findings.impact: Core reconciliation prompts cannot be executed as-is. The testrun_001/prompts/ directory contains placeholders instead of executable prompts.
findings.fix: Populate stub prompt files with the full content from final_reconciliation_prompt_pack/FULL_PROMPT_PACK.md phases

findings.issue: Dev compose web service depends_on api: condition: service_healthy, but the dev API service has no healthcheck defined (prod compose has it)
findings.impact: `docker compose up` will wait indefinitely for the API healthcheck to pass. Dev environment fails to start on fresh deployments.
findings.fix: Add healthcheck block to dev API service matching the prod pattern, or remove the condition from depends_on

findings.issue: All 4 worker processors (webhook-delivery, notification, search-indexer, cleanup) are TODO stubs that return mock responses - no actual work is performed
findings.impact: The worker service runs but does nothing. Webhook delivery, notification processing, search indexing, and cleanup are no-ops. The entire worker infrastructure is cosmetic.
findings.fix: Implement actual business logic in each processor, or remove the worker if processing happens in-process in the API

findings.issue: Dev Dockerfiles use node:20-alpine while production Dockerfiles use node:22-alpine - version mismatch between environments
findings.impact: Local dev runs on Node 20, production runs on Node 22. Behavior differences between versions may cause production-only bugs.
findings.fix: Align dev Dockerfiles to use node:22-alpine to match production

findings.issue: Terraform variable default droplet_size is s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb but tfvars uses s-2vcpu-2gb - default has not been updated after OOM upgrade documented in AGENTS.md
findings.impact: New deployments using defaults will provision undersized droplets that will OOM.
findings.fix: Update default droplet_size to s-2vcpu-2gb in variables.tf

findings.issue: Feature-flags module is the only one with logic in lib/ instead of modules/ with service.ts - every other module has co-located routes.ts + service.ts
findings.impact: Structural inconsistency makes the codebase harder to navigate. Move feature-flags logic from lib/ to modules/feature-flags/service.ts
findings.fix: Move feature-flags business logic to modules/feature-flags/service.ts

findings.issue: Duplicate migration files: 20260625000007_add_missing_indexes.sql and 20260627000001_add_missing_indexes.sql define overlapping indexes. Two data retention migrations exist (20260625000015, 20260627000002)
findings.impact: Unclear which migration is canonical. Risk of running superseded migrations on new databases.
findings.fix: Remove superseded migration files after verifying no production migration chain depends on them

findings.issue: push-subscription-service.ts is the only service file that doesn't follow service.ts naming convention
findings.impact: Inconsistent filename pattern. File should be service.ts or live in a subdirectory.
findings.fix: Rename to service.ts or extract to subdirectory

findings.issue: Cloud-init UFW firewall only opens ports 22, 80, 443 but DigitalOcean firewall allows LiveKit ports (7882-7892 UDP, 3478 UDP, 5349 TCP)
findings.impact: LiveKit TURN/WebRTC ports blocked by UFW despite DO firewall allowing them. Media/voice calls will fail.
findings.fix: Add UFW rules for LiveKit ports to cloud-init template

findings.issue: 8 docs files still reference the removed infra/docker/traefik/ directory
findings.impact: Stale documentation references that confuse readers about the current architecture.
findings.fix: Update or remove Traefik references from all 8 docs files

findings.issue: AGENTS.md claims setup-dev.sh uses wrong migration paths (packages/db/sql/) and that hardening.yml triggers on push/pull_request - both claims are incorrect/stale
findings.impact: Incorrect documentation misleads developers about the actual codebase state.
findings.fix: Update AGENTS.md to reflect current state: correct migration paths and actual hardening.yml triggers

findings.issue: Unicode/emoji icons used instead of SVG icons — poor contrast and inconsistent rendering across platforms
findings.impact: Accessibility: emoji icons have inconsistent rendering and may not be announced by screen readers consistently
findings.fix: Migrate Unicode icons to lucide-react SVG icons with proper aria-hidden and aria-label attributes

findings.issue: Loading state shows text 'Loading...' instead of skeleton component — inconsistent with rest of app
findings.impact: Poor user experience during loading — no visual placeholder for layout structure
findings.fix: Replace 'Loading...' text with Skeleton component matching workspace layout structure

findings.issue: Focus not returned to hamburger button after closing mobile sidebar via overlay click or Escape
findings.impact: Keyboard users lose context after closing sidebar — focus jumps to unexpected location
findings.fix: Store reference to trigger element and call .focus() after sidebar close

findings.issue: Create workspace trigger uses role='button' on a div with tabIndex=0 instead of native <button>
findings.impact: Not keyboard accessible in all browsers; no native button semantics (Space key may not activate)
findings.fix: Replace div with actual <button> element

findings.issue: Channel list items (Link elements inside role='listbox') lack aria-label identifying them as navigation items
findings.impact: Screen reader users cannot distinguish channel links from other list items
findings.fix: Add aria-label='Navigate to channel {channel.name}' on each channel Link element

findings.issue: Theme toggle button in app header may lack aria-label — ThemeToggle component from @chat/ui needs verification
findings.impact: Screen reader users may not know the theme toggle button's purpose
findings.fix: Ensure ThemeToggle component accepts and propagates aria-label prop

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut help menu — bulk actions require mouse
findings.impact: Power users cannot learn keyboard shortcuts; no documented shortcut reference
findings.fix: Add Ctrl+/ or ? keyboard shortcut help overlay; document common shortcuts

findings.issue: No i18n/internationalization support — lang='en' hardcoded
findings.impact: Screen reader pronunciation may be wrong for non-English content
findings.fix: Add next-intl or similar i18n library; make lang attribute dynamic

findings.issue: Search results use aria-selected but do not set aria-activedescendant on the search input
findings.impact: Screen reader cursor tracking is imprecise during keyboard navigation of search results
findings.fix: Set aria-activedescendant on the search input pointing to the currently highlighted result

findings.issue: Message log uses aria-live='polite' instead of 'assertive' for real-time chat
findings.impact: Screen readers may delay or omit announcing new messages in a high-velocity real-time chat context, causing users to miss incoming content.
findings.fix: Change aria-live to 'assertive' or use a dedicated live region that flips between 'polite' and 'off' to prevent excessive queuing.

findings.issue: Password input missing autocomplete attribute for password manager compatibility
findings.impact: Users relying on password managers cannot auto-fill credentials, creating a barrier for sign-in on repeat visits.
findings.fix: Add autocomplete='current-password' to the password input in sign-in mode and autocomplete='new-password' in sign-up mode.

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts dialog does not return focus to the triggering element on close
findings.impact: Keyboard and screen reader users lose their place in the document after dismissing the shortcuts dialog.
findings.fix: Store the previously focused element in a ref before opening and call .focus() on it when the dialog closes.

findings.issue: Notification menu does not programmatically focus the first item when opened
findings.impact: Keyboard users must tab through the entire document to reach the notification list.
findings.fix: After setting open=true, use requestAnimationFrame to call menuRef.current.querySelector('button, [href]')?.focus().

findings.issue: Auth loading spinner uses raw Tailwind class border-foreground instead of CSS custom property
findings.impact: The border-foreground class may not respect dark mode theme if not mapped to a CSS variable, reducing visual consistency.
findings.fix: Replace border-foreground with border-[var(--color-border-primary)] and border-t-transparent to match the rest of the codebase.

findings.issue: No message pagination in chat-view — fetches all messages at once with no cursor/offset limit
findings.impact: Long channels have unbounded load times and memory consumption
findings.fix: Implement cursor-based pagination: load initial 50 messages, fetch older on scroll-to-top

findings.issue: Typing indicator events not throttled on the server side — only client-side throttle at 2000ms
findings.impact: Rapid typing changes still fire many events; no server-side protection against flooding
findings.fix: Add rate limiting on socket typing:start events server-side; keep client throttle as defense-in-depth

findings.issue: Optimistic messages lack visual distinction (e.g., grayed out) for 'sending' state
findings.impact: Users cannot distinguish between pending (optimistic) and confirmed messages — confusion if message fails
findings.fix: Apply reduced opacity or spinner indicator to optimistic messages; revert on failure with toast error

findings.issue: Thread reply input uses fixed rows={2} — does not auto-resize unlike the main message input
findings.impact: Long thread replies require manual scrolling in the textarea; inconsistent with main message input UX
findings.fix: Replace fixed rows with auto-resize behavior matching message-input.tsx

findings.issue: No icon library — all icons are Unicode/emoji characters throughout the app
findings.impact: Inconsistent cross-platform rendering; no accessibility attributes on emoji icons; no SVG theming
findings.fix: Adopt an icon library (lucide-react recommended) with consistent aria-label and aria-hidden patterns

findings.issue: No typography scale or design tokens for heading/text variants — uses raw Tailwind classes
findings.impact: Inconsistent text sizing across pages; no design system guardrails for typography
findings.fix: Define typography scale tokens in globals.css; create Text and Heading components

findings.issue: Raw opacity values used directly (opacity-50, opacity-70, etc.) — no design tokens
findings.impact: Inconsistent transparency patterns across components
findings.fix: Define semantic opacity tokens (--opacity-disabled, --opacity-subtle, --opacity-overlay)

findings.issue: Notification dropdown lacks max-height — long notification lists extend beyond viewport
findings.impact: Users with many notifications cannot scroll within the dropdown; notifications overflow below viewport
findings.fix: Add max-h-96 overflow-y-auto to notification dropdown container

findings.issue: Reply-to bar shows only 'Replying to [name]' without preview of the replied-to message content
findings.impact: Users must remember or scroll to find the original message they're replying to
findings.fix: Add truncated preview of the replied-to message content below the name in the reply bar

findings.issue: Search results don't highlight the matched query terms in the excerpt
findings.impact: Users cannot quickly see why a result matched their search query
findings.fix: Highlight matching query terms in search result snippets using <mark> or bold

findings.issue: Message actions (reply, react, edit, delete) are hidden until hover — opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100
findings.impact: On touch devices or with mouse-free navigation, message actions are not visible
findings.fix: Show message actions always on mobile/touch; keep hover-with-focus pattern for desktop

findings.issue: No shared ButtonGroup component — login form mode toggle (Sign In/Sign Up) uses manually styled buttons
findings.impact: Inconsistent button group styling; no reusable pattern for segmented controls
findings.fix: Create shared ButtonGroup component with active state styling

findings.issue: CreateWorkspaceDialog swallows API errors in catch block without setting error state or user feedback
findings.impact: When workspace creation fails, the dialog simply resets the loading spinner with no error message.
findings.fix: Set error state in catch block (e.g. setError('Failed to create workspace')) and ensure Input displays the error prop.

findings.issue: MessageItem component receives 17+ props via manual drilling from MessageList, creating tight coupling
findings.impact: Adding features requires threading new props through all intermediate components. Component is impossible to reuse outside MessageList.
findings.fix: Consolidate callbacks into action handler objects (messageActions: { onReply, onEdit, onDelete, onThreadOpen }) and group display data into a dedicated interface.

findings.issue: Settings page notification changes are applied locally immediately but only persisted on manual Save, with no dirty-state indicator or unsaved changes warning
findings.impact: Users can change toggles, see visual feedback, and navigate away losing all changes without warning.
findings.fix: Add dirty-state flag showing 'Unsaved changes', implement beforeunload/navigation guard when dirty, or auto-save each toggle with debounce.

findings.issue: Auth loading state uses inline Tailwind class 'border-foreground' rather than a CSS custom property
findings.impact: Border color may not respond correctly to theme changes or dark mode, creating visual inconsistency.
findings.fix: Replace border-foreground with border-[var(--color-border-primary)] consistent with workspace loading.tsx skeletons.

findings.issue: Search author filter accepts raw UUID strings instead of offering member name autocomplete
findings.impact: Users must know exact user UUIDs to filter by author, making the feature effectively unusable.
findings.fix: Replace plain text input with member typeahead that searches workspace members by display name, resolving to UUID internally.

findings.issue: All pages use 'use client' directive — zero server components — full JS bundle downloaded on every route
findings.impact: No React Server Component benefits: no streaming SSR, larger initial JS payload, slower time-to-interactive
findings.fix: Convert non-interactive sections (landing page, workspace list) to server components; use 'use client' only where interactivity requires it

findings.issue: No route-level code splitting — all components eagerly imported via static imports
findings.impact: Large components (ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage) bundled into main chunk — slower initial load
findings.fix: Use next/dynamic for lazy-loading heavy components: ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage

findings.issue: No virtual list for long transcripts — all messages rendered as flat DOM nodes
findings.impact: Channels with thousands of messages cause full DOM rendering; unbounded memory growth; long session performance degrades
findings.fix: Implement virtual scrolling with react-window or @tanstack/react-virtual for message list

findings.issue: Reaction data fetched for ALL visible messages on every messages change — N+1 query pattern
findings.impact: Each message render triggers a batch reaction fetch; with 50 visible messages per page, significant overhead
findings.fix: Cache reaction data by message ID; only re-fetch when new messages appear in viewport

findings.issue: Avatar image uses instead of Next.js — no lazy loading or responsive images
findings.impact: Avatar images block initial load; no automatic srcset generation for responsive sizes
findings.fix: Replace with Next.js component with lazy loading

findings.issue: Socket.io client imported eagerly even on pages that don't need real-time (workspace overview, settings)
findings.impact: ~50KB socket.io client JS loaded on every page regardless of whether real-time features are used
findings.fix: Dynamic import socket.io client only on pages that require real-time features

findings.issue: All messages stored in single flat array — no pagination, windowing, or pruning of old messages
findings.impact: Long chat sessions accumulate unbounded memory; page grows slower over time
findings.fix: Limit in-memory message store to last N messages (e.g., 500); implement cursor-based load on scroll

findings.issue: transpilePackages: ['@chat/ui'] increases build time
findings.impact: Every pnpm build transpiles the shared UI package — necessary but can be optimized
findings.fix: Consider building @chat/ui as pre-compiled package to reduce transpilation overhead

findings.issue: react-markdown + remark-gfm bundled into the critical chat input chunk (~50KB gzipped) for a preview feature
findings.impact: Users who never open markdown preview still download the markdown parser. On mobile connections this adds significant latency.
findings.fix: Lazy-load the MarkdownPreview component via next/dynamic with ssr:false, only importing react-markdown when the preview toggle is activated.

findings.issue: Channel page is a client component with no route-level code splitting for sub-features (thread panel, media room, search)
findings.impact: All sub-feature bundles are loaded upfront even when never used (e.g. MediaRoom LiveKit imports on channels without calls).
findings.fix: Wrap ThreadPanel, MediaRoom, and SearchBar in next/dynamic() lazy imports with appropriate loading states.

findings.issue: NotificationBell fetches /notifications/unread every 30 seconds via setInterval even when the menu is closed
findings.impact: Persistent polling on mobile drains battery and consumes data. Multiple open tabs each poll independently.
findings.fix: Clear the interval when document.hidden or when the window loses focus; re-establish when visible again.

findings.issue: ThreadPanel fires an API call to fetch thread metadata on every mount but also on every replies.length change
findings.impact: Each thread open and each new reply triggers a redundant API call even when data was available in parent props.
findings.fix: Derive participant info from existing allMessages/reactions data when possible; only fetch thread metadata once per session.

findings.issue: Sentry.init() is called at module level in layout.tsx, not guarded by env check
findings.impact: Sentry JS bundle is always downloaded and initialized on every page load regardless of environment, adding ~30KB to initial bundle.
findings.fix: Guard Sentry import/init behind a dynamic import that only loads when NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN is set.

findings.issue: [F3] Message list has no virtualization — all messages rendered as flat DOM. No scroll anchoring. No cursor pagination.
findings.impact: Channels with 1000+ messages freeze browser. New messages push scrolled-up readers. Cannot load history beyond initial fetch.
findings.fix: Implement @tanstack/react-virtual with inverted scroll. Add scroll anchoring. Implement cursor-based pagination with scroll-to-top trigger.

findings.issue: [F6] No tablet-specific breakpoint — layout jumps from 3-column desktop to single-column mobile at 768px with no intermediate state
findings.impact: Tablet users on 768-1024px devices get cramped desktop or overly expanded mobile; no progressive collapse pattern
findings.fix: Add 1024px breakpoint: collapsed channel sidebar with slide-out drawer, always-visible workspace icons, compact message area

findings.issue: [F1] No semantic color or typography system — raw Tailwind values used throughout; theme changes require hundreds of per-component edits
findings.impact: Design system cannot be consistently themed or maintained; visual language drifts over time
findings.fix: Define complete semantic token system: --color-bg-*, --color-text-*, --color-border-*, --spacing-*, --font-size-*. Replace all raw values with tokens.

findings.issue: [F3] Message composer is a plain textarea — no rich editing, @mention autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop upload, markdown preview
findings.impact: Core composing experience lacks modern collaboration features; users cannot @mention, paste images, or preview markdown
findings.fix: Implement enhanced composer: @mention popover, emoji picker, drag-drop zone with progress, markdown preview toggle, /slash commands

findings.issue: [F5] No global keyboard shortcut help — users cannot discover available keyboard shortcuts for navigation or actions
findings.impact: Keyboard productivity features go unused; users cannot learn efficient workflows
findings.fix: Add Ctrl+/ shortcut help overlay listing all keyboard shortcuts: workspace nav, channel nav, search, message actions, media controls

findings.issue: [F7] All 9 pages use 'use client' directive — no React Server Components. No route-level code splitting.
findings.impact: Full JS bundle downloaded on every route; no streaming SSR; slow time-to-interactive on all pages
findings.fix: Convert non-interactive sections to server components; use next/dynamic for lazy-loading ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage

findings.issue: [F2] No global command palette (Ctrl+K) for searching and navigating to channels, users, settings
findings.impact: Navigation requires mouse or sidebar; no quick keyboard access to any context
findings.fix: Implement Ctrl+K command palette with fuzzy search across channels, recent conversations, users, settings pages

findings.issue: [F3] Thread panel lacks parent message context — users see replies without the original message quote or preview
findings.impact: Thread context is lost; users must navigate to parent message to understand the thread
findings.fix: Add sticky parent message card at top of thread with truncated content, timestamp, and clickable channel link

findings.issue: [F4] No optimistic updates for message sending — UI waits for API response before showing message
findings.impact: Noticeable delay between pressing Send and message appearing; chat feels sluggish
findings.fix: Implement optimistic send: temporary UUID, 'sending' indicator, replace on server confirmation, show retry on failure with inline error

findings.issue: [F6] No mobile bottom navigation bar — requires sidebar open for every context switch
findings.impact: Mobile navigation requires 3+ taps to switch channels; awkward one-handed use
findings.fix: Add mobile bottom tab bar with workspace button, channel list access, notifications bell, search icon, user menu

findings.issue: [F8] No notification sounds or subtle audio cues — @mentions and direct messages arrive silently
findings.impact: Urgent messages may be missed when user is not looking at the chat pane
findings.fix: Add configurable notification sounds for @mentions and DMs; mute setting per notification type

findings.issue: [F9] Unicode/emoji characters used as icons throughout (📱, 🔔, ↩, 😊, ✎, ✕) — no icon library
findings.impact: Inconsistent cross-platform rendering; no accessibility attributes; no theming support
findings.fix: Migrate to lucide-react icons with consistent aria-hidden and aria-label patterns; replace all Unicode icons

findings.issue: [F2] Breadcrumbs present but not clickable for workspace navigation
findings.impact: Users cannot navigate up the workspace hierarchy from breadcrumbs
findings.fix: Make breadcrumb segments clickable links; add dropdown on workspace name showing channel list

findings.issue: [F4] No 'Jump to present' button when scrolled up in message list
findings.impact: Users must manually scroll to bottom after reviewing history
findings.fix: Add floating 'Jump to present' FAB with unread count; appears when scrolled >500px from bottom

findings.issue: [F10] No Storybook for isolated component development and visual testing
findings.impact: New components must be developed in-page; no isolated testing environment
findings.fix: Install Storybook with @chat/ui package; create stories for Button, Input, Dialog, Avatar, Badge, Skeleton

findings.issue: [F10] Button component lacks danger and success semantic variants — only primary/secondary/ghost
findings.impact: Destructive actions use inconsistent styling; no semantic color-coded actions
findings.fix: Add danger (red), success (green), warning (amber) variants to Button; add loading state with spinner

findings.issue: Manual theme toggle broken - CSS only matches @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark), no .dark class selector
findings.impact: F1 integrity violation. ThemeProvider applies .dark class but CSS never matches it. All manual light/dark selections have no effect.
findings.fix: Add .dark selector alongside the media query or restructure to class-based theming

findings.issue: --color-accent-reference, accent-primary CSS variable referenced but never defined in any @theme block
findings.impact: Undefined CSS variable falls through to browser default. Callback page may render with incorrect colors.
findings.fix: Define --color-accent-primary in styles.css or replace with --color-brand-primary

findings.issue: No member list or member management page exists
findings.impact: F2 gap. Users cannot navigate to view or manage workspace members. Missing primary navigation target.
findings.fix: Add /members route with member list, role display, and invite UI

findings.issue: Thread replies cannot be edited, deleted, or reacted to
findings.impact: F3 gap. Thread replies are read-only after sending. Users cannot correct mistakes or express reactions in threads.
findings.fix: Add edit/delete actions and reaction support to thread panel

findings.issue: Duplicate --font-sans and --font-mono declarations in globals.css and styles.css
findings.impact: Minor F1 violation. Unnecessary duplication may lead to drift.
findings.fix: Remove duplicate font declarations from globals.css

findings.issue: No route-group-specific 404 page - invalid channels show inline 'Channel not found' text

findings.fix: Add not-found.tsx to (workspace) route group

findings.issue: No per-user presence indicators - only aggregate 'N online' count displayed

findings.issue: No reaction tooltip showing who reacted to a message

findings.issue: Mixed icon library usage - dialog uses Unicode '✕', sidebar-group uses Unicode '▸', toast uses inline SVGs, rest of app uses lucide-react

findings.issue: Thread replies area has no aria-live region for screen reader announcements

findings.fix: Add aria-live='polite' region to the thread reply list

findings.issue: Ctrl+1-9 workspace switching listed in help dialog but not implemented
findings.impact: F8 gap. Help dialog shows non-functional shortcuts, eroding user trust.
findings.fix: Implement workspace switching shortcuts or remove from help dialog

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts not discoverable - no UI hint or '?' icon anywhere
findings.impact: F8 minor. Power users may never discover the shortcut system exists.
findings.fix: Add a '?' button to app header or sidebar

findings.issue: Root error.tsx has empty useEffect(() => {}, [error]) - error not logged or reported
