findings.fix: Add console.error and Sentry.captureException to the useEffect

findings.issue: Avatar uses tag instead of Next.js Image component
findings.impact: F7 minor. Avatar images are not optimized, lazy-loaded, or responsively sized by Next.js.
findings.fix: Switch to Next.js Image component with priority for header avatars

findings.issue: search_messages RPC has no ts_rank relevance scoring — results not ordered by relevance
findings.impact: Search results are ordered by created_at rather than relevance; users see older/less relevant matches first
findings.fix: Update search_messages RPC to use ts_rank(tsvector, tsquery) for relevance scoring, order by rank DESC, created_at DESC as tiebreaker

findings.issue: Search API has no date range filter, author filter, channel filter, or pagination cursor
findings.impact: Users cannot narrow search by date, author, or channel; no pagination for large result sets
findings.fix: Extend search endpoint: add query params for date_from, date_to, author_id, channel_id (array), workspace_id; add cursor-based pagination

findings.issue: No file/attachment metadata indexed in search — file names and descriptions not searchable
findings.impact: File search requires separate indexing or storage-level search; users cannot find files by name
findings.fix: Add file_metadata table with searchable name/description columns; include in tsvector index or create separate search index

findings.issue: Search RPC uses SECURITY INVOKER but still has potential to leak channel visibility if auth.uid() is NULL (anon client)
findings.impact: Cross-channel search visibility relies on correct client; using anon client bypasses membership filter
findings.fix: Fix search route to use req.supabase (JWT client) instead of getSupabase() — addresses existing P0 finding

findings.issue: Search UI shows flat results with no date range or channel filter controls
findings.impact: Search UX is limited — users cannot filter results by date, channel, or author from the UI
findings.fix: Add search filter bar: date range picker, channel multi-select dropdown, author autocomplete; add result type indicators (message vs file)

findings.issue: No search performance benchmarks — no baseline for tsvector query latency under load
findings.impact: Search performance regressions go undetected as content grows
findings.fix: Create search performance test: measure p50/p95/p99 latency for common search patterns with varying result sizes

findings.issue: Author filter requires raw UUID input with no user autocomplete or display-name mapping
findings.impact: Users must know or look up workspace member UUIDs to filter by author; severely impacts usability.
findings.fix: Replace UUID text input with a user-picker dropdown showing workspace member names/avatars; send selected UUID to API.

findings.issue: No file or attachment metadata search — search_messages RPC indexes only the content column of messages
findings.impact: Users cannot search for messages by attached file name, description, or upload metadata.
findings.fix: Add a separate file_search RPC that searches file_attachments.name and file_attachments.description.

findings.issue: Search results use a hard result_limit=20 with no cursor or offset-based pagination
findings.impact: Only the top 20 results are returned; results beyond the first page are inaccessible.
findings.fix: Add cursor-based pagination (created_at + id) to the search_messages RPC parameters and API endpoint.

findings.issue: No deploy-time audit gating for production — deploy-production.yml runs without evaluating gate-policy.prod.json
findings.impact: P0/P1 findings can reach production with zero governance gate — the entire policy gating system is advisory
findings.fix: Add evaluate_gate.py step to deploy-production.yml before docker compose up, using gate-policy.prod.json with fail-on-violation

findings.issue: governance.yml and platform.yml workflows are broken on every push — call run_full.ps1 referencing 5 nonexistent scripts
findings.impact: CI noise on every push; no actual governance enforcement from these workflows
findings.fix: Fix or disable governance.yml and platform.yml; consolidate into working evaluate_gate.py invocations

findings.issue: Hotfix policy special_requirements (executive_signoff_required, rollback_plan_required, post_release_validation_required) are not enforced by any script
findings.impact: Hotfix policy is functionally identical to RC — three compensating controls are documented but never checked
findings.fix: Implement special_requirements enforcement in evaluate_gate.py and evaluate_promotion_gate.py

findings.issue: audit-pr-gate.yml uses dev policy for ALL PRs — PRs targeting main should use RC or prod policy
findings.impact: PRs to production branch evaluated against permissive dev thresholds (max_p1=5 instead of max_p1=0)
findings.fix: Make audit-pr-gate.yml policy file selection aware of target branch: dev-policy for develop, rc-policy for release/*, prod-policy for main

findings.issue: Duplicate policy file sets exist (hardening_super_bundle/policies/ and docs/audits/policies/) — risk of drift
findings.impact: Policy changes made to one set may not be reflected in the other — inconsistent gating
findings.fix: Consolidate to single source of truth (recommend hardening/policies/) with symlinks or CI sync check

findings.issue: Branch protection checks exist but only read-check and warn — no enforced required status checks on main
findings.impact: PRs can merge to main without passing audit gates, lint, or tests — no CI enforcement
findings.fix: Enforce branch protection via Terraform github_branch_protection resource or GitHub API; make audit-gate a required check

findings.issue: No approval process for policy file changes — any PR can silently relax gate thresholds
findings.impact: Developers can bypass governance by relaxing thresholds without review
findings.fix: Add CODEOWNERS for hardening/policies/* and hardening/rules/* requiring senior engineer approval

findings.issue: Hotfix gate not wired to any workflow — gate-policy.hotfix.json exists but no workflow references it
findings.impact: Hotfix tier is defined but unused; emergencies follow production path with no hotfix-specific controls
findings.fix: Create hotfix/* branch workflow with hotfix-policy; implement expedited deploy path with compensating controls

findings.issue: RC gate not wired to any workflow — gate-policy.rc.json exists but no workflow evaluates it
findings.impact: Release candidate tier is defined but completely unused in CI
findings.fix: Add RC evaluation to release branch PRs or a pre-deploy gate in the release workflow

findings.issue: No policy versioning or schema validation — policy files are ad-hoc JSON with no schema enforcement
findings.impact: Invalid policy entries may be silently ignored; no backward compatibility validation
findings.fix: Add JSON schema for policy files; add version field; validate policy format in CI

findings.issue: Exceptions.json is always empty — no historical exception tracking
findings.impact: Cannot audit how often policy gates were bypassed or what waivers were granted
findings.fix: Populate exceptions.json from PR audit gate overrides; add exception review workflow

findings.issue: No policy inheritance mechanism — each tier policy file is a full copy instead of extending a base
findings.impact: Policy changes must be duplicated across 4 files; risk of inconsistency
findings.fix: Implement base-policy.json with tier-specific overrides; merge at evaluation time

findings.issue: Governance workflow references nonexistent script — always fails at runtime
findings.impact: The sole governance CI workflow runs `pwsh ./scripts/automation/run_full.ps1` which does not exist. Any governance enforcement is effectively disabled.
findings.fix: Either create scripts/automation/run_full.ps1 with intended governance checks, or rewire governance.yml to use existing scripts: evaluate_gate.py, sync_baseline.py, and hardening pipeline runner.

findings.issue: governance.json is a 6-line stub with no tier definitions, inheritance, or environment mapping
findings.impact: No tier definitions for dev vs staging vs production, no P0/P1/P2 threshold differences, no policy versioning, no inheritance model.
findings.fix: Restructure governance.json as multi-tier policy document with tiers object containing development/staging/production keys, each with block_on thresholds, required_checks, approval_gates.

findings.issue: No hotfix bypass procedure or compensating controls documented for emergency deployments
findings.impact: During critical security incidents, engineers either delay the fix (extending outage) or bypass controls unsafely without defined compensating controls.
findings.fix: Document hotfix procedure: criteria (P0 outage, active exploit), approval flow (two-person review + on-call lead sign-off), compensating controls (post-deploy monitoring, 24h reversion plan, retrospective).

findings.issue: Policy changes are not reviewable or auditable — no policy-as-code review process
findings.impact: Changes to governance.json, core.rules.json can be made without oversight. A developer could silently weaken security thresholds.
findings.fix: Add CODEOWNERS entry requiring review for hardening/policies/. Add PR template checkbox for policy changes. Add CI validation of policy file structure against JSON schema.

findings.description: No sending indicator on optimistic messages
Missing tablet breakpoint in chat layout

findings.issue: No incoming webhook endpoint exists — cannot POST to channels from external systems
findings.impact: Core webhook feature completely absent; greenfield implementation required
findings.fix: Design POST /v1/webhooks/incoming/:webhookId/:secret endpoint that authenticates via URL token, validates signature (if present), transforms payload into message, and inserts into target channel

findings.issue: No incoming_webhooks table — no webhook registration, secret generation, or channel ownership model
findings.impact: Cannot create, manage, or revoke incoming webhook URLs per channel
findings.fix: Create incoming_webhooks table: id UUID PK, channel_id FK, name TEXT, secret TEXT (hashed), created_by FK, is_active BOOLEAN, last_used_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at

findings.issue: No incoming webhook rate limiting or payload size limits — external systems could flood channels with messages
findings.impact: Without abuse controls, a misconfigured or compromised webhook could DoS a channel
findings.fix: Add per-webhook rate limiting (max 30 req/min), max payload size (1MB), payload validation with Zod schema, optional HMAC signature verification

findings.issue: No payload formatting/templating strategy — incoming JSON payload needs transformation into rich chat message
findings.impact: Raw JSON payloads are not user-friendly; need structured message formatting (title, description, color, fields, footer)
findings.fix: Design payload formatter: support common webhook formats (Slack-compatible, GitHub, GitLab, Datadog) with fallback to raw JSON embed

findings.issue: No webhook management UI in frontend — cannot create, view, or revoke incoming webhooks from app
findings.impact: Users must use API directly to manage webhooks — poor UX
findings.fix: Add webhook management page under channel settings: create webhook, copy URL, regenerate secret, view delivery logs, revoke

findings.issue: No incoming webhook test coverage — invalid payloads, expired secrets, flood conditions, rate limiting
findings.impact: Webhook delivery reliability untested; abuse controls may not work as designed
findings.fix: Write tests: valid webhook POST creates message, invalid signature returns 401, rate limit exceeded returns 429, oversized payload returns 413

findings.issue: Webhook secrets stored as plaintext in the `secret` column with no encryption at rest
findings.impact: A database dump or SQL injection exposes all webhook secrets, allowing attackers to forge valid HMAC signatures.
findings.fix: Encrypt secrets at rest using pgcrypto (pgp_sym_encrypt) or application-level AES-GCM; decrypt only in memory at delivery time.

findings.issue: DNS rebinding bypass possible: resolveHostname only resolves IPv4 (A records), has no TTL caching, and does not pin resolved IPs
findings.impact: An attacker controlling DNS for their webhook URL can initially resolve to a public IP, pass validation, then switch to 10.0.0.1.
findings.fix: Add AAAA (IPv6) resolution, enforce minimum TTL caching, and validate IP at the connection level.

findings.issue: No webhook payload formatter or templating — payload is always { event, ...payload } with raw internal schema
findings.impact: Consumers receive internal domain schema with no ability to transform fields, rename keys, or inject computed values.
findings.fix: Add per-webhook format config (JSON template, Liquid/Handlebars) and a transforms pipeline for key mapping.

findings.issue: No webhook management frontend UI — no settings page or dialog to create, test, or monitor webhooks
findings.impact: Users must interact with the API directly; no visibility into delivery logs, retry status, or dead-letter queue.
findings.fix: Build a webhook management section in workspace settings with CRUD forms, delivery log viewer, manual retry button, and test-ping endpoint.

findings.issue: Message list renders ALL visible messages as DOM nodes — no virtualization, no windowing, no inverted scroll
findings.impact: Channels with 1000+ messages cause 10000+ DOM nodes; browser freezes on large channels; OOM on long sessions
findings.fix: Integrate @tanstack/react-virtual with estimatedItemSize for variable-height messages; implement inverted scroll (load older on scroll up, anchor at bottom for new messages)

findings.issue: No cursor-based pagination for loading older messages — chat-view fetches once without pagination
findings.impact: Cannot load channel history beyond initial fetch; no infinite scroll up
findings.fix: Implement cursor-based pagination: fetch initial 50 messages, detect scroll-to-top, pass cursor for next page, insert older messages at top while maintaining scroll position

findings.issue: No scroll anchoring for new messages — new messages push existing content down, losing user scroll position
findings.impact: When user scrolls up to read history, new incoming messages shift the viewport; user loses their place
findings.fix: Implement scroll anchoring: detect if user is near bottom (within 200px), auto-scroll on new messages; if scrolled up, maintain position with offset adjustment

findings.issue: Virtual list could break keyboard navigation — screen readers need aria-setsize and aria-posinset on virtualized items
findings.impact: Keyboard users may lose focus tracking or experience non-sequential navigation in virtualized list
findings.fix: Add aria-setsize and aria-posinset to each virtualized message; ensure focus management with virtual focus tracking; test with NVDA/VoiceOver

findings.issue: Unread indicators and jump-to-present behavior not supported with current flat message rendering
findings.impact: Users cannot mark position and jump to latest messages after reviewing history
findings.fix: Add unread marker (visual separator), 'Jump to present' button (appears when scrolled up), and 'New messages' indicator

findings.issue: No virtualization performance benchmarks — no baseline for DOM nodes, memory usage, or scroll FPS
findings.impact: Performance improvement from virtualization cannot be measured or validated
findings.fix: Create performance benchmark: measure DOM node count, memory usage, scroll frame rate at 100, 1000, and 10000 messages

findings.issue: Fixed row height estimate of 64px causes scroll jank with variable-height messages (long content, reactions, thread reply links)
findings.impact: React Virtualizer recalculates item positions on each render pass, causing the scroll bar to jump and the user to lose visual context.
findings.fix: Use virtualizer.measureElement with data-index attributes on each row for dynamic measurement.

findings.issue: Unread count is calculated as Math.floor(messages.length * visibleRatio) — approximate ratio instead of tracking actual unseen message boundaries
findings.impact: Miscounts unread messages when messages have varying heights; cannot show precise new-message markers.
findings.fix: Store ID of last visible message on scroll, compute unread count as messages.indexOf(lastSeenId); render visual 'new messages' divider.

findings.issue: Prepending older messages during cursor pagination shifts visible content downward with no scroll anchoring compensation
findings.impact: When loadOlder appends messages to the beginning of the array, currently viewed messages are pushed down, causing visual jump.
findings.fix: After prepending older items, adjust scrollTop by total height of newly inserted items.

findings.issue: No tablet-specific breakpoint — layout jumps from desktop 3-column to mobile single-column at 768px, no intermediate state
findings.impact: Tablet users on 768-1024px devices get either cramped desktop or overly expanded mobile layout
findings.fix: Add tablet breakpoint (1024px): collapsed channel sidebar with slide-out drawer, always-visible workspace list icons, compact message area

findings.issue: Mobile sidebar overlay lacks smooth animations and swipe-to-close gesture
findings.impact: Mobile navigation feels abrupt; users cannot swipe-close sidebar, must tap small overlay area
findings.fix: Add CSS transition for sidebar slide-in/out, implement swipe-to-close gesture detection on mobile, add backdrop blur for visual depth

findings.issue: No bottom navigation tab bar on mobile — users cannot switch between channels or workspaces without sidebar
findings.impact: Mobile navigation requires opening sidebar for every context switch; inefficient UX
findings.fix: Add mobile bottom tab bar: workspace switcher, channel list access, notifications bell, search shortcut, user menu

findings.issue: Thread panel on mobile overlaps full screen with no back-navigation — users cannot see channel context while in thread
findings.impact: Mobile thread UX traps users; no split-view or side-panel pattern for smaller screens
findings.fix: Mobile thread: full-screen thread view with back arrow returning to channel, preserved scroll position on return, swipe-right to go back

findings.issue: No responsive layout tests in Playwright — mobile and tablet viewports not tested
findings.impact: Layout changes for responsive design have zero automated regression coverage
findings.fix: Add Playwright viewport tests: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1440px (desktop); verify all 3 columns visible on desktop, collapsed sidebar on tablet, single column on mobile

findings.issue: Media call room covers entire viewport on mobile with no minimize or picture-in-picture mode
findings.impact: Mobile users in a call cannot access chat, threads, or navigate the app without leaving the call entirely.
findings.fix: Implement a minimized floating PiP overlay for mobile when navigating away from the call view.

findings.issue: Tablet auto-collapse uses unthrottled window resize listener and snaps between collapsed/expanded with no animation
findings.impact: Rapid window resizing may cause performance jank; instantaneous snap at breakpoint boundaries feels unpolished.
findings.fix: Debounce resize handler with requestAnimationFrame; add CSS transition on sidebar width.

findings.issue: Thread panel has fixed width w-80 (320px) on desktop with no sizing variant for smaller viewports
findings.impact: On 1024px-wide screens with sidebar open, the thread panel consumes ~30% of remaining space, leaving a narrow chat column.
findings.fix: Use responsive width: w-72 at md, w-80 at lg, and allow user resizing with a drag handle.

findings.issue: Message list uses fixed padding (pb-14) for mobile bottom nav instead of responsive spacing aware of nav height
findings.impact: If mobile bottom nav height varies, messages at the bottom may be clipped or have excessive whitespace.
findings.fix: Replace pb-14 with env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + dynamic calculation based on actual nav element height.

findings.issue: Existing k6 load tests only hit / and /healthz endpoints — no real API endpoints tested at all
findings.impact: Load tests provide no insight into actual system behavior under load — false sense of load-readiness
findings.fix: Replace k6 test scripts with meaningful scenarios: message send, workspace/channel listing, search, WebSocket connect

findings.issue: k6 is not invoked in any CI workflow — load tests exist but never run
findings.impact: No load regression detection in CI — performance degradation goes unnoticed until production
findings.fix: Add k6 smoke test (1 VU, 30s) to validate.yml; add full load test as nightly workflow

findings.issue: No WebSocket load test: concurrent socket connections, message send, and message delivery latency
findings.impact: Realtime system behavior under load completely unknown — socket fanout could become bottleneck
findings.fix: Build k6 WebSocket scenario: 50+ concurrent connections, each sending messages, measure p50/p95/p99 delivery latency

findings.issue: No search load test — concurrent search queries with varied terms
findings.impact: Full-text search performance under load unknown — could cause DB CPU spikes
findings.fix: Build k6 search scenario: concurrent search queries with varied terms, measure response time, verify result accuracy

findings.issue: No notification fanout load test — one message triggering notifications for many members
findings.impact: Notification delivery latency under load unknown — push notification queue could back up
findings.fix: Build k6 scenario: one message triggers notification for 100 members, measure notification delivery latency

findings.issue: No reconnect storm load test — all sockets disconnect simultaneously
findings.impact: Reconnect behavior under stress unknown — server may not handle simultaneous reconnection
findings.fix: Build k6 scenario: 100+ concurrent sockets, disconnect all, measure reconnect time and message recovery

findings.issue: 18 Prometheus metrics defined but not consumed by k6 thresholds — k6 checks don't reference metrics
findings.impact: Cannot set metric-based pass/fail thresholds in load tests
findings.fix: Add metric endpoint polling to k6 test thresholds (error rate < 1%, p95 latency < 2000ms)

findings.issue: No capacity assumptions or success criteria documented for any load scenario
findings.impact: Cannot determine if load test results are acceptable — no baseline for comparison
findings.fix: Document expected capacity: max concurrent users, message rate, notification throughput; set k6 thresholds accordingly

findings.issue: k6 not declared as devDependency — requires separate CLI install
findings.impact: Load testing setup friction — no standard version pinned across team
findings.fix: Add k6 as devDependency or add Docker-based k6 runner script

findings.issue: No load test report artifact published in CI
findings.impact: Load test results not visible in PRs or dashboards — no trend tracking
findings.fix: Add k6 report output as CI artifact; consider Grafana k6 integration for dashboard

findings.issue: Existing k6 tests only exercise the /healthz endpoint — zero load tests exist for message send, socket connect, search, or notification paths
findings.impact: No load testing data exists for the core chat send path (POST /messages), WebSocket connection churn (socket.io reconnect storms), search queries (search_messages RPC), or notification delivery. Production capacity assumptions are entirely unverified.
findings.fix: Add k6 scenarios for: (1) POST /messages concurrent sends with dedup verification, (2) Socket.IO connection burst (1000 concurrent connects with immediate channel:join), (3) search_messages RPC under concurrent load, (4) notification delivery burst. Define success criteria for each scenario.

findings.issue: Notification fanout (e.g., @everyone or channel join notifications) blocks the message send handler sequentially
findings.impact: A single @everyone mention triggers sequential notification sends to every workspace member. With 500 members, this blocks the message handler for seconds. Under concurrent sends, this creates a compounding delay as each request waits for previous notification fanout to complete.
findings.fix: Move notification fanout to a background job queue. Replace await notificationService.sendBatch() with queue.add('send_notifications', { payload }). Implement a worker that processes notifications with a concurrency limit of 10-20 parallel deliveries.

findings.issue: Idempotency key store uses in-memory Map with no eviction or size limit — unbounded memory growth under load
findings.impact: The idempotency Map stores every idempotency key indefinitely with 24h TTL. Under load test with 10K+ concurrent requests, the Map grows without bound, eventually causing OOM or increased GC pressure affecting all request latency.
findings.fix: Add Map eviction: use a LimitedMap class that caps entries (e.g., 10,000) and evicts oldest entries. Implement periodic cleanup interval. Add memory usage monitoring to the /metrics endpoint.

findings.issue: No latency histograms or percentile tracking for critical API endpoints (messages, search, socket)
findings.impact: During load tests, operators can only see request counts and error rates, not P50/P95/P99 latency. Without latency percentiles, capacity planning is based on averages that mask tail latency problems from GC pauses or lock contention.
findings.fix: Add Histogram metrics for: message_send_duration_ms, message_list_duration_ms, search_duration_ms, socket_connect_duration_ms. Use prometheus Histogram buckets appropriate for each endpoint (e.g., 10ms-5000ms range).

findings.issue: Thread support exists (parent_id FK) but no thread metadata, participant tracking, reply counts, or unread count logic
findings.impact: Threaded conversations cannot be built on current schema without significant DB and API changes
findings.fix: Add thread_metadata table, thread_participants table, thread_last_read tracking, thread unread count infrastructure

findings.issue: Notification system has basic CRUD but no @mention parsing, @role/@everyone support, channel muting, or offline queues
findings.impact: Mention-driven communication and granular notification control completely absent
findings.fix: Implement mention parsing at message create time, mention validation, notification preference model, offline queue storage

findings.issue: RBAC has only owner/admin/member roles with no channel-level override model or custom roles
findings.impact: Granular channel permissions, hidden channels, and role-based channel access impossible
findings.fix: Design role hierarchy with channel override model; add channel_role_overrides table; update middleware chain

findings.issue: Message list renders all messages as flat DOM with no virtualization — no virtual list, no inverted scroll, no windowing
findings.impact: Channels with thousands of messages cause OOM and browser freezes
findings.fix: Integrate @tanstack/react-virtual with inverted scroll support; implement cursor-based pagination on scroll-to-top

findings.issue: Message input is a plain textarea with no rich text, markdown preview, @mention autocomplete, emoji picker, or drag-drop
findings.impact: Core message input lacks modern collaboration features; no inline media or mention support
findings.fix: Implement enhanced textarea with mention autocomplete (#channels, @users), emoji picker, drag-drop file upload, markdown preview

findings.issue: No WebRTC/STUN/TURN infrastructure for audio/video — no media server, no signaling channel, no ICE configuration
findings.impact: Audio/video collaboration feature requires new infrastructure: TURN server, signaling service, room management
findings.fix: Design WebRTC architecture: consider LiveKit, Daily.co, or self-hosted mediasoup for media server

findings.issue: Full-text search exists via search_messages RPC but has no date range filter, file metadata search, or search ranking
findings.impact: Search is functional but limited — no advanced filtering or relevance ranking
findings.fix: Add tsvector ranking with relevance scoring, date range filtering, file metadata search, paginated results

findings.issue: No incoming webhook endpoints exist — only outgoing webhook delivery pipeline
findings.impact: External systems cannot post messages into channels via webhook URLs
findings.fix: Design incoming webhook registration model, payload formatting, secret generation, rate limiting

findings.issue: No optimistic UI system — all mutations wait for API response before updating UI
findings.impact: Chat feels sluggish; no zero-latency interaction pattern
findings.fix: Create optimistic state management: temporary IDs for messages, reactions, edits; rollback on failure; deduplicate on server echo

findings.issue: No background job/worker infrastructure for async processing (notification fanout, webhook delivery queuing)
findings.impact: Feature expansion will require worker processes; current architecture has no job queue or worker pattern
findings.fix: Design job queue abstraction (Bull/BullMQ with Redis), worker process pattern, job retry/dead-letter handling

findings.issue: Current theme supports only light/dark/system — no slate dark, OLED high-contrast black, or multi-theme architecture
findings.impact: Theme engine needs expansion to support multiple named themes with SSR-safe hydration
findings.fix: Expand CSS variable token system for multiple themes; implement SSR-safe theme hydration with cookie-based persistence

findings.issue: No responsive breakpoint strategy for tablet — only desktop (768px+) and mobile (full-screen overlays)
findings.impact: Tablet users get suboptimal layout; no three-column layout adaptation for medium screens
findings.fix: Design three-column layout with proper collapse/restore behavior at 1024px, 768px, and 480px breakpoints

findings.issue: No E2E or integration tests for any of the 5 core features (threads, mentions, RBAC, webhooks, search)
findings.impact: Feature expansion without test coverage will produce regressions in production
findings.fix: Write test matrix covering all 11 features with unit, integration, E2E, and performance tiers

findings.issue: Thread panel exists but has no thread participant tracking, thread-specific unread counts, or join/leave semantics
findings.impact: Thread feature lacks participant isolation and thread-specific UX patterns
findings.fix: Add thread participant model, thread unread counts, thread join/leave API, thread notification preferences

findings.issue: No feature flag system wired to application code — 5 seed flags exist but control nothing
findings.impact: Cannot use feature flags to safely roll out new features incrementally
findings.fix: Wire feature flag evaluation into feature boundaries: threads, mentions, webhooks, search improvements, new editor

findings.issue: No release gate process for feature expansion — no checklist, no sign-off, no staged rollout plan
findings.impact: Feature releases have no quality gate beyond existing CI checks
findings.fix: Implement feature release gate with: P0/P1 resolution check, migration safety, E2E coverage threshold, feature flag rollout plan

findings.issue: TypeScript types significantly out of sync with DB schema — must regenerate before any feature work
findings.impact: New feature development will produce type errors or require any-casts
findings.fix: Run supabase gen types typescript before starting feature implementation

findings.issue: No media/WebRTC support at all — no WebRTC service, no media streams, no device permission management
findings.impact: Audio/video media is a greenfield feature requiring new infrastructure, new API service, and new frontend
findings.fix: Phase 3: evaluate LiveKit for managed WebRTC; design signaling protocol; implement media grid UI

findings.issue: No shared @mention or autocomplete infrastructure — search-bar.tsx has its own search, no reusable mention picker
findings.impact: Mention autocomplete in message input requires building from scratch
findings.fix: Create shared MentionPicker component with debounced user/channel search, keyboard navigation, and position anchoring

findings.issue: No Storybook or component development environment for building new UI components

findings.fix: Install Storybook with @chat/ui package; create stories for new feature components

findings.issue: No avatar URL validation — avatar URLs are stored as-is with no format or security check
findings.impact: Malformed or malicious avatar URLs could cause issues in theme/display
findings.fix: Add avatar_url validation in profile update schema

findings.issue: No emoji picker component — reactions use hardcoded emoji buttons
findings.impact: Users cannot browse/search emojis for reactions or rich text input
findings.fix: Integrate emoji-mart or emoji-picker-react for reaction and editor use

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut documentation or help menu
findings.impact: Power users cannot discover shortcuts for new features (mentions, threads, media controls)
findings.fix: Document keyboard shortcuts in app; add Ctrl+/ shortcut help overlay

findings.issue: Theme/appearance system exists only as CSS custom properties with no user-facing theme switcher, dark mode toggle, or theme persistence
findings.impact: Users cannot customize visual appearance; no dark mode support limits accessibility and user preference satisfaction.
findings.fix: Implement a theme context provider that hot-swaps CSS custom property values. Create a theme switcher component in user preferences. Persist choice to user_preferences table.

findings.issue: BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) layer listed as PENDING — no middleware layer exists between Next.js frontend and Express API for request aggregation or transformation
findings.impact: Frontend makes direct API calls to /v1/* endpoints with no opportunity for request aggregation, response shaping, or auth token refresh at the edge.
findings.fix: Implement Next.js API routes (./app/api/) as a BFF proxy layer that aggregates requests, handles token refresh, shapes responses for frontend consumption.

findings.issue: File upload flow has no E2E test coverage despite UI implementation in MessageInput with drag-drop and file selection
findings.impact: File upload regressions (S3 presigned URL failures, content-type issues, upload progress bugs) would not be caught by CI.
findings.fix: Add Playwright E2E test for file upload flow: select file → upload → verify message appears with file attachment. Add test for drag-drop and upload failure.

findings.issue: Feature inventory documents 15 features but no formal feature registry or capability matrix exists — feature overlap rate is 45% across 624 audit findings
findings.impact: Without a canonical feature registry, teams cannot determine which features are complete, partially implemented, or planned.
findings.fix: Create a FEATURES.md at root with a capability matrix listing each feature, its status (complete/partial/missing), owning module(s), and verification test.

findings.issue: Message input is a simple <textarea> with no rich editing capabilities — no markdown, no mentions, no emoji, no drag-drop
findings.impact: Core message input must be completely re-architected for rich editing — cannot incrementally enhance a plain textarea
findings.fix: Choose enhanced-textarea architecture (TipTap/ProseMirror for rich editing, or textarea with overlay components for simpler approach); implement markdown preview, slash commands, and keyboard shortcuts

findings.issue: No mention/channel autocomplete popover — @ and # triggers have no suggestion UI
findings.impact: Users must type exact @usernames and #channel-slugs from memory; no discoverability
findings.fix: Implement @mention popover: trigger on @keypress, debounced user search across workspace members, keyboard navigation (arrow keys + Enter), multi-word display names with avatar. Same pattern for #channel autocomplete.

findings.issue: File upload is a separate API call with no inline drag-drop or paste support in message input
findings.impact: Users must use separate upload UI; no inline image pasting or drag-drop from desktop
findings.fix: Implement drag-drop zone on message input area, paste event handler for images, upload progress indicator in compose bar, attachment preview pills before send

findings.issue: No emoji picker in message input — users cannot add emoji to messages from compose UI
findings.impact: Emoji usage requires typing :emoji_name: manually or using separate emoji picker for reactions only
findings.fix: Integrate emoji-mart or custom emoji picker: trigger on :keypress or toolbar button, frequently used/recent emoji section, search/filter

findings.issue: Rich editor risks breaking keyboard accessibility — arrow keys, Enter, and Escape in autocomplete must not interfere with normal text editing
findings.impact: Keyboard users may be unable to type @ or # characters normally, or autocomplete may trap focus
findings.fix: Ensure keyboard navigation: Escape closes autocomplete without selecting, Backspace on empty mention removes mention chip, Enter selects without submitting form

findings.issue: No tests for paste, drag-drop, emoji, or mention interaction flows
findings.impact: Rich editor UX changes will ship without regression coverage
findings.fix: Write Playwright tests: paste image creates upload, drag-drop file shows preview, @mention selects user, emoji picker inserts emoji

findings.issue: File upload via fetch() PUT has no progress tracking or upload speed indicator
findings.impact: Large file uploads appear unresponsive; users receive no feedback on progress, leading to confusion and potential premature navigation.
findings.fix: Replace fetch with XMLHttpRequest upload progress events or use fetch + ReadableStream tracking to report percentage completion.

findings.issue: No clipboard paste handler for images — users cannot paste screenshots directly
findings.impact: Power users expecting paste-as-upload (common in Slack/Discord) must use file selector or drag-drop.
findings.fix: Add onPaste handler to textarea that detects ClipboardEvent.files containing image/* entries.

findings.issue: Emoji picker limited to 24 hardcoded common emojis with no search, skin-tone variants, or category filtering
findings.impact: Users cannot find most emojis without memorizing positions; no search means tedious scrolling.
findings.fix: Integrate a full emoji picker library with search, categories, skin-tone selector, and recent emojis.

findings.issue: Autocomplete only supports @mentions of users; no #channel autocomplete
findings.impact: Users cannot autocomplete channel names in composition, limiting discoverability of workspace channels.
findings.fix: Extend autocomplete to detect # prefix and fetch channel list, rendering channel suggestions alongside member suggestions.

findings.issue: notificationService.list() and unreadCount() use getSupabase() (anon client) instead of per-user authenticated Supabase client
findings.impact: All notification read operations use the anonymous client with RLS enforcing user_id filter — defense-in-depth weakness if RLS is misconfigured.
findings.fix: Refactor list() and unreadCount() to accept an optional SupabaseClient parameter. Pass req.supabase from the route handlers.

findings.issue: @here mention resolves identically to @everyone by selecting all workspace members without filtering for currently online/active users
findings.impact: @here is intended to notify only currently online workspace members, but the implementation notifies all members regardless of presence status.
findings.fix: Integrate with Socket.io presence tracking: query currently active user IDs from the Redis presence store or socket rooms when resolving @here.

findings.issue: Mention notification titles use truncated UUID (input.user_id.slice(0,8)) instead of resolved display name
findings.impact: Notification reads like 'a1b2c3d4 mentioned you' instead of 'Alice mentioned you'. Raw UUIDs are user-hostile.
findings.fix: Look up the sender's display_name from the users/profiles table before constructing the notification title.

findings.issue: Notification unread count polls every 30 seconds instead of using real-time WebSocket push
findings.impact: Users experience up to 30 seconds of delay between a mention being created and the notification bell badge updating.
findings.fix: Emit a 'notification:new' or 'notifications:unread_update' Socket.io event when notificationService.create() succeeds.

findings.issue: No @mention parsing at message creation time — no detection of @user, @role, @everyone, @here patterns
findings.impact: Mention-driven notifications are completely absent; users cannot @mention each other
findings.fix: Implement mention parser that runs at message create: extract @username patterns, resolve to user IDs, validate membership, create notification records

findings.issue: No offline notification queue — notifications created only for currently connected users via in-memory operations
findings.impact: Offline users miss notifications; no persistent inbox for missed @mentions or thread replies
findings.fix: Create notification_queue table: all notifications persisted on send; delivered via push/websocket on user reconnect

findings.issue: No notification_preferences table — users cannot control which notifications they receive per channel or per type
findings.impact: Every notification goes to every workspace member; no mute, no channel-level suppression
findings.fix: Create notification_preferences: user_id FK, workspace_id FK (null=global), channel_id FK (null), notification_type TEXT, enabled BOOLEAN. Set sensible defaults.

findings.issue: No @role or @everyone mention support — mention system must resolve role members and workspace members
findings.impact: Broadcast mentions (@everyone, @channel) and role-targeted mentions (@admin, @moderator) not possible
findings.fix: Extend mention parser: @everyone resolves to all workspace members, @role resolves to workspace_members with that role

findings.issue: No mention autocomplete UI in message input — users must type @username manually with no suggestion dropdown
findings.impact: Mention discoverability is poor; users must know exact usernames
findings.fix: Implement @mention autocomplete popover: debounced search, keyboard-navigable list, multi-word display names

findings.issue: No channel muting or notification suppression rules — channel level mute/unmute not supported
findings.impact: Users cannot mute noisy channels; notification fatigue
findings.fix: Add channel mute flag to notification_preferences; filter notifications at delivery time based on mute rules

findings.issue: Notification bell shows count but no distinction between mention types (@user vs @everyone vs thread reply)
findings.impact: Users cannot prioritize notifications; all notification types visually identical
findings.fix: Add notification type icons/coloring: @mention highlight, thread reply indicator, @everyone warning style

findings.issue: No abuse/edge-case tests for mentions: self-mention, mention of non-member, @everyone spam, mention flood
findings.impact: Mention system vulnerable to abuse without rate limiting or validation
findings.fix: Add mention rate limiting (max 10 @mentions per message), self-mention check, non-member validation; write tests

findings.issue: Request ID is generated but not propagated to downstream services — no distributed tracing context
findings.impact: Cross-service debugging (API -> Supabase -> webhook -> worker) requires manual log correlation. Operators cannot trace a user-facing failure end-to-end.
findings.fix: Add x-request-id propagation to all outgoing HTTP requests, worker task payloads as trace_id, and Supabase queries via pg settings.

findings.issue: Audit log retry queue is in-memory and non-durable — events lost on process restart
findings.impact: If the API process restarts (deploy, crash, OOM), all queued audit events are permanently lost including compliance-relevant actions.
findings.fix: Replace in-memory array with Redis-backed queue or persistent audit_queue table. Implement background worker with exponential backoff.

findings.issue: Error handler metadata omits HTTP method and route path from log context
findings.impact: When debugging error spikes, operators cannot quickly identify which endpoint is failing without cross-referencing request IDs.
findings.fix: Add method: req.method, path: req.path, and route: req.route?.path to log metadata in both AppError and unhandled error branches.

findings.issue: Incident runbook diagnosis steps don't reference Sentry error traces or Prometheus metrics dashboards
findings.impact: During incidents, operators follow runbook diagnosis steps but are not directed to Sentry for error clustering or /metrics for performance baselines.
findings.fix: Add diagnosis steps: 'Check Sentry for error traces and regression', 'Check Prometheus metrics at /metrics for anomaly spikes'.

findings.issue: No application-level alerting configured — no error rate, latency, auth failure, or health check alerts
findings.impact: Production incidents detected only when users report them — no proactive notification of system degradation
findings.fix: Configure Sentry alert rules for error threshold breaches and PagerDuty/Slack integration; add Prometheus alert rules

findings.issue: No external uptime monitoring service configured — no Pingdom, Checkly, Better Uptime, or UptimeRobot
findings.impact: Complete downtime is only detected when users report it or Docker HEALTHCHECK notices locally — no external view
findings.fix: Add free-tier uptime monitoring (UptimeRobot or Better Uptime) that checks /healthz every 5 minutes

findings.issue: DigitalOcean alerts (CPU>80%, Memory>80%, Disk>90%) only go to email — no PagerDuty, Slack, or SMS integration
findings.impact: Critical infrastructure alerts may be missed if email notifications are not monitored promptly
findings.fix: Add Slack webhook or PagerDuty integration to DO monitoring alerts

findings.issue: No automatic request logging middleware — every log line must include request context manually
findings.impact: Inconsistent log context; some requests produce no access log; correlation requires manual context passing
findings.fix: Add auto-request-logging middleware that captures method, path, status code, duration, and request ID for every request

findings.issue: No distributed tracing — only basic request IDs, no OpenTelemetry, span propagation, or trace correlation across services
findings.impact: Cannot trace a single user action across API -> DB -> WebSocket -> webhook; debugging complex failures requires manual log correlation
findings.fix: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation for Express, database queries, and external HTTP calls

findings.issue: No log shipping or aggregation — logs are local Docker container stdout; no Papertrail, Logtail, Axiom, or Loki
findings.impact: No centralized log search; logs lost on container restart; cannot alert on log patterns
findings.fix: Add Docker log driver to send logs to a cloud log aggregation service; or add logagent sidecar

findings.issue: 18 Prometheus metrics exposed but no remote collector, dashboard, or alert rules consume them
findings.impact: Metrics are generated and exposed but never visualized or alerted on — observability gap
findings.fix: Set up Grafana dashboard consuming API /metrics endpoint; define alert rules for error rate and latency

findings.issue: Frontend has no structured logging — console.log/error used ad-hoc
findings.impact: Client-side issues cannot be diagnosed from logs; no structured frontend telemetry
findings.fix: Add frontend logging library (e.g., loglevel) with remote log shipping for production errors

findings.issue: Audit event queue is in-memory — lost on process restart; no Redis-backed persistence
findings.impact: Audit events during restart window are lost; compliance gap for sensitive operations
findings.fix: Replace in-memory queue with Redis-backed persistent queue or write directly with retry

findings.issue: Health checks only validate database connectivity — no check for Redis, Supabase Storage, or external service availability
findings.impact: Health check can pass while critical dependencies (Redis, Storage) are down
findings.fix: Add dependency checks for Redis (if configured), Supabase Storage connectivity, and circuit breaker states

findings.issue: No business metrics dashboard — active users, messages/day, workspace growth not visualized anywhere
findings.impact: Business stakeholders lack visibility into platform growth and adoption
findings.fix: Create Grafana dashboard with business metrics: daily active users, messages/day, workspaces created, reactions

findings.issue: No audit event for read operations (SELECT queries) — only mutation events are logged
findings.impact: Unauthorized read access to sensitive data leaves no audit trail
findings.fix: Add audit logging for read operations on sensitive data (user search, workspace member list, audit log views)

findings.issue: No distributed tracing — only basic request IDs, no span propagation across API -> DB -> WebSocket -> webhook -> background jobs
findings.impact: Cannot trace a single user action across service boundaries; debugging complex failures requires manually correlating log timestamps across services with no shared trace ID
findings.fix: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation for Express, Supabase queries, Socket.io events, and outbound HTTP calls; propagate trace context via headers

findings.issue: No automatic request logging middleware — every request log line must be manually emitted, leading to inconsistent log coverage
findings.impact: Some requests produce no access log at all; cannot audit all API calls; correlation requires manual context passing
findings.fix: Add auto-request-logging middleware that captures method, path, status code, duration, and request ID for every request before route handler

findings.issue: Request ID is not propagated to Socket.io events, background jobs, or outbound webhook calls
findings.impact: Cannot correlate WebSocket events or webhook deliveries with originating API request — making debugging of async flows impossible
findings.fix: Attach request ID to Socket.io event payloads; pass to worker tasks; include in outbound webhook X-Request-ID header

findings.issue: 18 Prometheus metrics defined but no remote collector configured — metrics sit in memory and are only accessible via unauthenticated /metrics endpoint
findings.impact: Metrics are generated but never aggregated, alerted on, or visualized; the entire metrics infrastructure has no consumer
findings.fix: Configure Prometheus remote write or set up a Grafana Cloud integration to push metrics; configure retention and alert rules

findings.issue: Push notification delivery failures logged via console.error instead of structured logger.error — no structured context, no trace ID, no error taxonomy
findings.impact: Push notification failures are invisible in centralized logging; cannot alert on failure rate or diagnose types of failures
findings.fix: Replace console.error with logger.error including structured context: notification type, user agent, endpoint, error code, request ID

findings.issue: Health checks validate only database connectivity — no Redis, Supabase Storage, or external dependency checks
findings.impact: Health check can pass 'healthy' while critical dependencies are down, giving false confidence to orchestrator
findings.fix: Add optional dependency checks for Redis (if REDIS_URL configured), Supabase Storage endpoint, and circuit breaker states

findings.issue: Audit event queue is in-memory — events lost on process restart; no Redis-backed persistence
findings.impact: Audit trail gaps during deploy windows; compliance risk for sensitive operations
findings.fix: Replace in-memory queue with Redis-backed Bull queue with persistent storage

findings.issue: Frontend has no structured logging — only console.log/error used ad-hoc with no consistent format
findings.impact: Client-side errors cannot be diagnosed from logs; no frontend telemetry for UX monitoring
findings.fix: Add frontend logging library (loglevel or pino-web) with remote log shipping; integrate with Sentry breadcrumbs

findings.issue: No worker health endpoint nor Prometheus metrics — apps/worker has zero observability instrumentation
findings.impact: Worker failures (stuck jobs, OOM, queue backlogs) are invisible until users report symptoms
findings.fix: Add health endpoint and basic metrics (jobs processed, queue depth, error rate) to apps/worker

findings.issue: 14 of 17 Prometheus metrics defined but never emitted - only HTTP request count/duration, WebSocket connections gauge, and webhook delivery counter are actually populated
findings.impact: Business metrics for messages, auth attempts, workspaces, channels, reactions, notifications, files, search, circuit breaker status, and idempotency are all dead code. Production monitoring is blind to all business activity.
findings.fix: Call recordWebsocketMessage, recordDbQuery, recordAuthAttempt, recordMessageCreated, etc. at the appropriate points in services and middleware

findings.issue: Worker has no Sentry integration - no initSentry(), no captureException(), no error tracking at all
findings.impact: Worker crashes and job processing errors are completely invisible. Sentry has zero visibility into worker failures.
findings.fix: Add Sentry.init() to worker bootstrap and wrap job handlers with Sentry.captureException

findings.issue: Correlation IDs are not automatically injected into log lines - no pino child loggers are created. requestId is manually included in only 4 log calls across the entire codebase.
findings.impact: Cannot trace a single request across multiple log lines. Debugging production issues requires correlating log timestamps manually.
findings.fix: Create a pino child logger per request with requestId, replace the root logger with the child logger in middleware

findings.issue: No manual Sentry.captureException() calls anywhere in the API codebase - only auto-capture from Express error middleware
findings.impact: Critical errors caught in catch blocks (e.g. webhook delivery failure, GDPR delete failure) are logged but never sent to Sentry. Silent data integrity issues.
findings.fix: Add Sentry.captureException(err) to all catch blocks in critical paths (webhooks, GDPR, auth, messages, payment flows)

findings.issue: API /healthz endpoint checks DB but does not check Redis connectivity
findings.impact: If Redis is down (cache, idempotency, Socket.io adapter all affected), the health endpoint reports 'healthy' despite critical dependency being unavailable.
findings.fix: Add Redis PING check to the health service, report 'degraded' if Redis is unreachable

findings.issue: x-request-id is not returned in response headers - clients cannot correlate requests to server-side traces
findings.impact: Client-side debugging cannot connect HTTP responses to server log entries. Support teams cannot correlate user reports to specific requests.
findings.fix: Add res.setHeader('x-request-id', req.requestId) in the request-id middleware

findings.issue: Socket.io events have no correlation IDs - cannot trace WebSocket message flows across services
findings.impact: When a message send event fails, there is no correlation ID to link the Socket.io event to the server-side processing. Debugging real-time issues is manual.
findings.fix: Generate correlation IDs on Socket.io connection/auth, propagate to all event handlers

findings.issue: setCircuitBreakerStatus() metric function exists but is never called from circuit-breaker.ts events
findings.impact: Circuit breaker state changes (open/closed/half-open) are invisible in Prometheus. Cannot detect when external services are failing via circuit breaker metrics.
findings.fix: Wire circuit-breaker.ts 'open'/'close'/'halfOpen' events to call setCircuitBreakerStatus()

findings.issue: Message sending is synchronous — waits for API response before showing message in list
findings.impact: Noticeable delay between pressing Send and message appearing; chat feels sluggish
findings.fix: Implement optimistic send: generate temporary UUID, add message to state immediately with 'sending' flag, replace ID on server confirmation, show retry on failure

findings.issue: No temporary entity ID strategy — message, reaction, and edit operations all use real IDs from server
findings.impact: Cannot perform optimistic updates without knowing the final ID; delays all mutation feedback
findings.fix: Create temporary ID generation strategy (crypto.randomUUID()); map temp IDs to server IDs on confirmation; reconcile state

findings.issue: No rollback visual feedback — when optimistic update fails, user sees no error indication or retry mechanism
findings.impact: Failed sends silently disappear; users must retype messages
findings.fix: Show failed message inline with 'Failed to send — tap to retry' banner; preserve message content in local draft on failure

findings.issue: No deduplication strategy for server echoes — when server confirms via WebSocket, optimistic message may duplicate
findings.impact: Duplicate messages appear when server echoes back the same message that was optimistically inserted
findings.fix: Use temporary UUID as dedup key: on receiving socket message:new, check if temp ID exists in state; if yes, replace with server data; if no, insert as new

findings.issue: Reactions, edits, and deletes are not in optimistic UI scope — only message sends considered
findings.impact: Partial optimistic coverage; reaction and edit feedback still delayed
findings.fix: Extend optimistic engine: optimistic reaction toggle (immediate visual change, revert on failure), optimistic edit (immediate update, revert on server reject)

findings.issue: Optimistic updates are only applied to message send; edit, delete, and reactions call the API synchronously with no optimistic placeholder
findings.impact: Edit/delete/reaction interactions feel slower because the UI waits for the server round-trip before updating.
findings.fix: Wrap handleEdit and handleDelete in useOptimistic with temp-ID rollback; apply optimistic reaction toggles locally before the API call.

findings.issue: deduplicateEcho uses a synchronous boolean read from inside a setItems callback to check for duplicates, which may produce stale reads under React concurrent rendering
findings.impact: Under React concurrent mode or batched state updates, the synchronous exists check may incorrectly return false, causing duplicate messages.
findings.fix: Use useRef<Set<string>> to track seen IDs outside the state update cycle for server-echo deduplication.

findings.issue: Failed optimistic sends are silently removed with no inline retry UI — the rollback simply filters out the temp message
findings.impact: Users see their message disappear after a send failure with no way to retry, causing confusion and data loss.
findings.fix: Display inline retry button on failed messages using the errors map from useOptimistic; implement resubmit callback.

findings.issue: TypeScript types are severely out of sync with DB schema — 6 types defined vs 16 tables exist; soft-delete fields missing
findings.impact: Feature expansion will produce type errors across all packages; developers forced to use 'any'
findings.fix: Run supabase gen types typescript --local > packages/db/src/types.ts before starting feature implementation; add CI check for type-schema drift

findings.issue: No background job infrastructure — no job queue (Bull/BullMQ), no worker process, no scheduled task framework
findings.impact: Notification fanout, webhook delivery retry, search indexing, and media processing all require async workers; current architecture handles these synchronously or not at all
findings.fix: Design job queue abstraction: Redis-backed BullMQ for Node.js, worker process pattern (apps/worker/), job retry/DLQ handling, scheduled job support for retention/pruning

findings.issue: API versioning uses /v1/ prefix but no version negotiation headers (Accept-version, Sunset, Deprecation)
findings.impact: Expanding API for new features cannot gracefully deprecate old endpoints; breaking changes affect all clients
findings.fix: Implement version negotiation: Accept-Version header support, Deprecation/Sunset headers on old versions, version migration guide in docs

findings.issue: No down/rollback scripts for any existing 26 migrations — feature expansion adds more migrations without rollback capability
findings.impact: Schema changes for 11 new features will compound the rollback problem; forward-fix becomes only option
findings.fix: Write down scripts for existing ALTER TABLE migrations (#14-16); mandate down scripts for all future migrations

findings.issue: No business analytics or feature usage tracking — cannot measure adoption of new features
findings.impact: Cannot determine whether feature investments (threads, mentions, search) are being used or are having impact
findings.fix: Add feature usage tracking: create feature_events table (event_type TEXT, user_id, metadata JSONB); instrument feature entry points; create adoption dashboard

findings.issue: No realtime event naming convention or registry — socket events are ad-hoc in service files
findings.impact: New feature realtime events will have inconsistent naming; clients must reverse-engineer event payloads
findings.fix: Create realtime event registry (TypeScript enum or const object) in packages/realtime/ with typed payloads for all events

findings.issue: No API contract validation between frontend and backend — types are duplicated or manually maintained
findings.impact: Frontend/backend contract drift for new features will cause silent production failures
findings.fix: Create packages/contract/ with shared API request/response types shared between apps/api and apps/web; add JSON Schema validation or use tRPC

findings.issue: Feature flags exist in DB but are not wired to code — cannot dark-launch new features
findings.impact: New features must be deployed all-at-once; no gradual rollout or kill-switch capability
findings.fix: Wire featureFlagService.evaluateFlag() into feature boundaries before implementing new features; set up flag evaluation in frontend via API

findings.issue: No background job infrastructure — webhook delivery retry, notification fanout, mention processing, search indexing all run synchronously or as fire-and-forget promises
findings.impact: Webhook delivery failures block message creation; mention/notification processing adds latency; no retry/DLQ for delivery failures.
findings.fix: Add Redis-backed BullMQ job queue in apps/worker/; move webhook delivery, notification fanout, mention processing, and search indexing to async jobs.

findings.issue: No formal realtime event naming registry — WebSocket events are ad-hoc string literals hardcoded in service files
findings.impact: Inconsistent event naming for new features; no TypeScript safety for event payloads; no event contract documentation.
findings.fix: Create packages/realtime/ with typed event registry (constants + payload interfaces); reference from server emit() and client on().

findings.issue: deprecationMiddleware exists but DEPRECATED_ROUTES is always empty — no active version deprecation management
findings.impact: Cannot gracefully deprecate old API versions or endpoints when expanding the API.
findings.fix: Populate DEPRECATED_ROUTES with actual sunset dates; add Accept-Version header negotiation; document API version lifecycle.

findings.issue: No shared API contract package between apps/api and apps/web — types are independently defined
findings.impact: Frontend/backend contract drift risk for new features; no single source of truth for API shapes.
findings.fix: Create packages/contract/ with Zod schemas for all API request/response types shared between both apps.

findings.issue: Changes to deployment workflows and infra/terraform can be applied without human approval — no required reviewers on deploy jobs
findings.impact: Critical deployment/infra changes can reach production without review, violating approval gate requirements
findings.fix: Add environment: production with required reviewers; add CODEOWNERS for infra/ and .github/workflows/

findings.issue: Single SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF for both dev and prod — no separate Supabase project per environment
findings.impact: Migrations from develop directly affect same database as main
findings.fix: Use separate Supabase projects with separate project ref secrets per environment

findings.issue: E2E tests all marked test.skip — zero E2E coverage despite having 48 test stubs and Playwright configured
findings.impact: No E2E baseline before edits; cannot detect UI regression during reconciliation
findings.fix: Establish at minimum auth and workspace E2E tests as baseline before reconciliation edits

findings.issue: SMTP/email env vars not set in any deployment workflow — SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, EMAIL_FROM all missing
findings.impact: Password reset and transactional emails non-functional in deployed environments
findings.fix: Add SMTP configuration secrets to all deploy workflows

findings.issue: Multiple .env.example files exist across apps with inconsistent variable coverage — no single source of truth for required env vars
findings.impact: New environment setup requires cross-referencing multiple files; missing vars not caught until runtime
findings.fix: Consolidate to root .env.example as canonical source; validate all vars documented

findings.issue: No Terraform plan step in deploy workflows — terraform apply runs without plan review
findings.impact: Infrastructure changes applied without human review of planned changes
findings.fix: Add terraform plan step with approval gate before apply

findings.issue: No explicit CODEOWNERS file defining required reviewers for sensitive paths
findings.impact: Anyone can modify auth, DB, infra, or deployment files without specialized review
findings.fix: Create CODEOWNERS: @MaineCyberTech/security for auth/supabase/, @MaineCyberTech/infra for terraform/, @MaineCyberTech/ops for deploy workflows

findings.issue: Worker package has no test script configured in package.json
findings.impact: Worker code changes during reconciliation have zero test coverage
findings.fix: Add vitest config and test script to apps/worker/package.json

findings.issue: No checkpoint branch created before reconciliation — no git tag marking pre-reconciliation state
findings.impact: Cannot easily revert to pre-reconciliation state if edits cause issues
findings.fix: Create git tag pre-reconciliation-baseline before any reconciliation edits

findings.issue: No baseline captured for lint/typecheck/test pass before reconciliation edits
findings.impact: Cannot distinguish pre-existing failures from reconciliation-introduced issues
findings.fix: Run and capture pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test output as baseline artifact

findings.issue: Playwright test results (.playwright-results/) and generated coverage reports not gitignored
findings.impact: Generated artifacts may be committed during reconciliation file passes
findings.fix: Add .playwright-results/ and coverage/ to .gitignore

findings.issue: No explicit documentation of which files/folders are off-limits during reconciliation
findings.impact: Reconciliation AI may modify critical config files without understanding impact
findings.fix: Document off-limits paths: apps/api/src/config/, supabase/migrations/, infra/terraform/, .github/workflows/deploy-*

findings.issue: Workspace member list returns email field in API response — all workspace members can see each other's email addresses
findings.impact: PII (email addresses) exposed to all workspace members unnecessarily; email enumeration across workspace membership
findings.fix: Remove email from getMembers() SELECT query; return only display_name and avatar_url; log access for audit

findings.issue: GDPR delete route does not clean up audit_logs or consent_logs — user's data remains after account deletion
findings.impact: GDPR Right to Erasure not fully implemented; user's audit trail and consent records persist after deletion
findings.fix: Add explicit deletion of audit_logs and consent_logs entries for the user in the GDPR delete endpoint

findings.issue: User email logged in workspace list operations via userEmail in authenticate middleware — PII in structured logs
findings.impact: Email addresses flow into production log aggregation services where retention may be long and access broad
findings.fix: Log only userId, not userEmail; if email is needed for debugging, mask it (e.g., j***@example.com)

findings.issue: User search endpoint returns email in search results — GET /v1/auth/search?q= partial email search enabled
findings.impact: Email enumeration via search — attacker can probe if specific email addresses have accounts on the platform
findings.fix: Exclude email from search results entirely; search only by display_name; rate-limit search to 10 queries/min/user

findings.issue: No data retention policy enforced — audit_logs and notifications grow unbounded; no scheduled purge exists
findings.impact: User data retained indefinitely; GDPR 'right to be forgotten' lifecycle not implemented; storage grows without bound
findings.fix: Implement pg_cron scheduled job to purge audit_logs > 90 days, notifications > 30 days, consent_logs > 1 year; document retention periods

findings.issue: avatar_url stored as raw TEXT with no validation — could contain tracking pixels or external references that leak user activity
findings.impact: Third-party tracking via avatar URLs: when email clients load avatars, referer headers leak workspace context
findings.fix: Proxy avatar images through API server; add Content-Security-Policy: img-src 'self'; validate avatar URLs against allowlist

findings.issue: No data processing register or GDPR compliance documentation in repository
findings.impact: Cannot demonstrate GDPR compliance without documented data processing activities
findings.fix: Create docs/compliance/gdpr-data-processing-register.md listing all PII fields, processing purposes, retention periods, and lawful bases

findings.issue: getProfiles() returns email column for all requested users - any authenticated user can batch-request any user IDs and receive email addresses
findings.impact: Email addresses (direct PII identifiers) are exposed to all authenticated users via the profiles endpoint. No access scoping beyond authentication.
findings.fix: Remove email from the SELECT in getProfiles(). Only return display_name and avatar_url for non-owner requests.

findings.issue: GDPR account deletion does not clean up: audit_logs, consent_logs, webhook_endpoints, thread_metadata, thread_participants, channel_role_overrides, notification_preferences, webhook_deliveries
findings.impact: After 'deletion', user data persists in 8+ tables. Violates GDPR right to erasure (Article 17). Audit trail of the deletion itself is missing, making compliance non-demonstrable.
findings.fix: Add deletion queries for all missing tables. Create audit log entry recording the deletion. Wrap in transaction.

findings.issue: GDPR data export does not include: audit_logs, consent_logs, reactions, channel_members, webhook_endpoints, webhook_deliveries
findings.impact: Incomplete data portability. User receives partial data request and cannot verify what data is held about them.
findings.fix: Add queries for all missing data categories to the export endpoint

findings.issue: GDPR account deletion creates no audit log entry - deletion itself is invisible
findings.impact: Cannot demonstrate compliance with GDPR deletion requests. No record of when or by whom an account was deleted.
findings.fix: Call logAuditEvent before or after the deletion sequence, recording the deletion request

findings.issue: Rate limiter logs raw IP addresses via logger.warn on rate limit hits
findings.impact: IP addresses logged in plaintext. In EU jurisdictions, IP is considered PII. Accumulated rate-limit logs become a PII dataset without clear retention policy.
findings.fix: Hash or mask IP addresses before logging, or log only the subnet prefix (/24 for IPv4)

findings.issue: No data retention is actually running - all 6 pg_cron.schedule calls are commented out. Old PII (audit_logs with IP addresses, consent_logs) accumulates indefinitely.
findings.impact: Old audit_logs containing user IDs and IP addresses, and consent_logs with IP addresses and user agents, are never purged. Non-compliant with data minimization principle.
findings.fix: Enable pg_cron extension and activate data retention scheduling for audit_logs (90 days) and consent_logs (1 year)

findings.issue: Migration 08 removes channel_role_overrides checks from channels_select_member and messages_select_member RLS policies, moving deny-enforcement entirely to the application middleware
findings.impact: If any code path queries channels or messages without going through requireChannelAccess middleware, the deny overrides are not enforced.
findings.fix: Restore the NOT EXISTS deny-override check using the SECURITY DEFINER channel_workspace() helper to avoid circular dependency.

findings.issue: channelService.getMembers()/addMember()/removeMember() use getSupabase() (anon client) without accepting a per-user authenticated client
findings.impact: Channel member operations bypass any per-user RLS context. The getMembers() call returns all members regardless of calling user's membership.
findings.fix: Refactor channelService methods to accept an optional SupabaseClient parameter. Use req.supabase from route handlers.

findings.issue: No frontend admin UI exists for managing channel role overrides despite the full table schema and API support
findings.impact: Workspace admins cannot manage channel-level access controls through the UI. Admins must use raw SQL or API calls.
findings.fix: Add a 'Channel Settings' dialog with 'Access Overrides' tab. Show current overrides with add/remove controls.

findings.issue: Role enumeration is inconsistent: CHECK uses 'admin','moderator','member','guest', workspace service uses 'owner'|'admin'|'member'
findings.impact: Role definitions drift between layers. 'owner' is valid but not in override CHECK. 'guest' and 'moderator' have no code paths.
findings.fix: Unify role definitions in packages/db/. Align CHECK constraint with workspace role definitions. Remove unused roles.

findings.issue: No channel-level permission override model — all channel access is binary (member of workspace = can see all public channels)
findings.impact: Cannot restrict specific channels to specific roles; hidden/staff-only channels impossible
findings.fix: Design permission matrix: workspace roles (Admin, Moderator, Member, Guest) + channel overrides (allow/deny per role or per user). Precedence: explicit deny > explicit allow > workspace role default.

findings.issue: No channel_role_overrides table — cannot define per-role or per-user channel access exceptions
findings.impact: Channel-level access control requires new database table plus RLS changes
findings.fix: Create channel_role_overrides: channel_id FK, role TEXT (or user_id UUID nullable), permission TEXT (allow/deny), scope TEXT (read/write/admin). Unique (channel_id, role) or (channel_id, user_id)

findings.issue: Current RLS policies for channels and messages are binary — workspace member sees all public channels. No override resolution logic.
findings.impact: RLS must be updated to consider channel_role_overrides for hidden channels and restricted content
findings.fix: Update channel SELECT RLS: if channel has override restricting role=user_role, exclude from results. Add admin-bypass policy for workspace admins.

findings.issue: No channel settings UI for managing role overrides — cannot configure channel permissions from frontend
findings.impact: Channel permission management requires direct DB access or API calls
findings.fix: Add channel settings page with members tab showing current role assignments and override controls (channel admin only)

findings.issue: Channel access middleware checks workspace membership but not channel-level role overrides
findings.impact: Middleware bypasses channel-level permissions; overrides only enforced at RLS level (bypassable if service_role client used)
findings.fix: Add channel_role_override check to requireChannelAccess middleware: if user has explicit deny on channel, return 403

findings.issue: No privilege escalation or hidden-channel leakage tests
findings.impact: RBAC changes risk introducing authorization bypasses without detection
findings.fix: Write test cases: user without channel override cannot access channel, user with explicit deny gets 403, admin bypasses overrides, hidden channel not in list

findings.issue: 956 total findings include ~45% overlap — 568 raw findings deduplicate to ~310 unique items. Finding 'message virtualization missing' appears in 7 prompts (API contract, frontend, UX, accessibility, performance, chat UX, release gate) at varying severities P0-P2.
findings.impact: Effort estimation based on raw count is overestimated by ~55%. Missing virtualization could be over-valued or under-valued depending on which severity is adopted.
findings.fix: Deduplicate before prioritization: adopt the highest severity across duplicates. Track virtualization once as consolidated finding: 'Message list needs virtualization for channels with >500 messages'. Fix scope: message-list.tsx with @tanstack/react-virtual.

findings.issue: Gate policy dev.json sets max_p0=0 but 145 P0 findings exist. The policy threshold is unrealistic — 145 P0 items cannot be resolved in one sprint. A more graduated gate is needed.
findings.impact: Gate always fails across all environments. Gate becomes noise — operators learn to ignore FAIL status.
findings.fix: Adopt graduated gate thresholds: max_p0=10 (must be security/auth only), max_p1=50, min_readiness=50%. Re-evaluate thresholds quarterly as backlog shrinks.

findings.issue: Evidence summary references Repomix snapshots of 'main' and 'develop' codebases. Current repo is a unified monorepo that has diverged from both reference snapshots. Reconciliation against stale snapshots produces irrelevant comparisons.
findings.impact: All reconciliation recommendations based on snapshot comparison are suspect. Only findings grounded in actual codebase inspection should be trusted.
findings.fix: Flag all snapshot-derived findings as low-confidence. Use only codebase-grounded findings (the 956 pipeline findings) for prioritization.

findings.issue: Multiple prompts recommend 11 new features (threads, mentions, RBAC, webhooks, search, editor, themes, virtual list, optimistic UI, responsive, media). But infra audit shows no Redis, no worker, no rollback scripts, no E2E baseline. Feature expansion on fragile infrastructure risks destabilizing existing working features.
findings.impact: Infrastructure hardening must precede feature expansion, but no single artifact enforces this ordering.
findings.fix: Declare Phase 0 (infra hardening: Redis, worker, rollback, E2E baseline) as prerequisite gate before any Phase 1 feature work. Document in reconciled roadmap.
