findings.impact: Any workspace member can escalate their own role to admin, add/remove other members, or change roles
findings.fix: Add admin/owner role verification in POST/PATCH/DELETE workspace member routes

findings.issue: Webhook secret stored in plaintext and returned in API responses to all workspace members
findings.impact: Any workspace member can read other webhook secrets — if webhook is used for CI/CD, full pipeline access
findings.fix: Encrypt webhook secret at rest using pgcrypto; mask secret in API responses with last 4 chars only

findings.issue: Socket.io has allowEIO3: true enabling Engine.IO v3 legacy protocol with known vulnerabilities
findings.impact: Expanded attack surface — Engine.IO v3 has known vulnerabilities and fewer security features than v4
findings.fix: Set allowEIO3: false unless backward compatibility is proven necessary

findings.issue: No per-event Socket.io rate limiting — channel:join, typing:start/stop events not rate-limited
findings.impact: Malicious client can flood socket events, degrading service for all users
findings.fix: Add per-socket event rate limiting with configurable window and max count

findings.issue: CSRF cookie has httpOnly: false — any XSS can exfiltrate the double-submit token
findings.impact: If XSS exists, CSRF protection is completely bypassed as the token is readable by JavaScript
findings.fix: Add additional CSRF layer (origin/referer checking) on top of double-submit cookie pattern

findings.issue: CSP allows cdn.jsdelivr.net for scripts — broad CDN allowlist enables script injection from any package on that CDN
findings.impact: If an attacker finds an XSS vector, they can load malicious scripts from jsdelivr
findings.fix: Remove CDN wildcard; use specific integrity-hashed URLs for required external scripts

findings.issue: CSP lacks nonce-based protection for inline scripts
findings.impact: Any injected <script> tag executes in browsers that don't support strict-dynamic or if CSP is not properly enforced
findings.fix: Implement nonce-based CSP for all inline script tags

findings.issue: wget installed in production Docker image — unnecessary package expands attack surface
findings.impact: Extra package in runtime image can be used as attack vector if other vulnerabilities exist
findings.fix: Remove wget; use built-in health check mechanism or curl if needed

findings.issue: Webhook secrets stored in plaintext in webhook_endpoints table - no encryption at rest
findings.impact: DB compromise leaks all webhook secrets. Any actor with DB read access (e.g. via SQL injection, backup exposure) obtains secrets for outgoing webhooks.
findings.fix: Encrypt secrets using pgcrypto at insert time, decrypt only at delivery time

findings.issue: GET /consent returns ALL consent records across all users - no user_id filter
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can read other users' cookie/analytics/marketing consent choices. Direct PII exposure of consent preferences.
findings.fix: Add .eq('user_id', req.userId) filter to the query

findings.issue: Thread participants, join, and leave endpoints have no channel membership check. Thread data accessible to any authenticated user.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can enumerate thread participants, join threads in any channel, and view thread membership without being a workspace member.
findings.fix: Add requireChannelAccess middleware to thread routes

findings.issue: Feature flag CRUD endpoints have no admin role check - any authenticated user can create/update/delete feature flags
findings.impact: Any user can modify feature flags affecting all workspaces. Can enable/disable features globally without authorization.
findings.fix: Add requireAdmin or requireWorkspaceOwner middleware to feature-flag mutation endpoints

findings.issue: General API rate limiter uses IP-only key, not composite user+IP key like auth and search limiters
findings.impact: Attacker can rotate IP addresses to bypass the 100 req/min limit. IP-only keys are trivial to circumvent with botnets.
findings.fix: Change keyGenerator from default to compositeKey (same as authLimiter)

findings.issue: requireMessageAccess middleware uses getSupabase() (anon client) for message lookup instead of req.supabase (user JWT client)
findings.impact: Initial message lookup bypasses RLS policies. Though later checks add membership validation, the first query runs without user context.
findings.fix: Replace getSupabase() with req.supabase for the initial message lookup

findings.issue: SSRF IP-blocking does not filter 0.0.0.0 or IPv6 [::] addresses
findings.impact: Attacker pointing webhook URL to 0.0.0.0:PORT may bypass SSRF protection on some systems. IPv6 localhost not filtered.
findings.fix: Add '0.' and '[::]' to blocked IP prefixes list, and resolve IPv6 addresses

findings.issue: CSP style-src uses 'unsafe-inline' instead of nonce-based approach
findings.impact: Inline styles permitted broadly. Nonce-based CSP would provide stronger protection against CSS injection attacks.
findings.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonce-based style loading where feasible

findings.issue: Trivy vulnerability scanner uses @master mutable tag — not pinned to a specific SHA or semver
findings.impact: Supply chain risk: a compromised or updated @master could introduce malicious code into CI pipeline without review
findings.fix: Pin trivy-action to a specific SHA (e.g., aquasecurity/trivy-action@595be6a...) or semver tag (e.g., @v0.28.0)

findings.issue: Trivy action also uses @master tag in build-push.yml — same supply chain issue
findings.impact: Supply chain risk across two CI workflows using unpinned mutable reference
findings.fix: Pin trivy-action to a specific SHA in build-push.yml as well

findings.issue: pnpm audit threshold set to --audit-level=moderate — only blocks moderate+ severity; high/critical advisories pass if below moderate threshold
findings.impact: High-severity dependency vulnerabilities may not block CI; false sense of security from audit check
findings.fix: Set --audit-level=high to at minimum block high-severity vulnerabilities; consider blocking at critical level

findings.issue: wget installed in production Docker image — unnecessary package increases runtime attack surface
findings.impact: Extra package in production container provides additional attack vector for RCE exploits
findings.fix: Remove wget from production Dockerfile; use curl or HEALTHCHECK built-in instead

findings.issue: Docker multi-stage builds use npm ci and then discard devDependencies, but pnpm store is not cleaned — final image may contain package manager artifacts
findings.impact: Unnecessary layer bloat increases image size and attack surface
findings.fix: Add pnpm store prune and .pnpm-store directory cleanup in final stage

findings.issue: No Dependabot or Renovate configuration for automated dependency updates — .github/dependabot.yml does not exist
findings.impact: Dependency vulnerabilities may go unnoticed until manually discovered; no automated PRs for security patches
findings.fix: Create .github/dependabot.yml with weekly checks for npm, GitHub Actions, and Docker dependencies

findings.issue: Dockerfile has HEALTHCHECK (good) but no USER directive — containers run as root by default
findings.impact: If container is compromised, attacker has root access inside the container
findings.fix: Add 'USER appuser' after installing dependencies; create appuser in Dockerfile

findings.issue: Worker Dockerfile missing HEALTHCHECK instruction - Docker will not monitor container health
findings.impact: If the worker process becomes unresponsive (stuck job, deadlock), Docker/Host orchestrator will not detect the failure or restart the container. Silent worker outage.
findings.fix: Add HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --retries=3 CMD wget --spider http://localhost:4100/healthz || exit 1

findings.issue: Dependabot GitHub Actions ecosystem has no version grouping - each action version bump creates a separate PR
findings.impact: Noise from individual action update PRs may cause developers to ignore or batch-merge updates without review. Missed security-critical version bumps.
findings.fix: Add groups: block for GitHub Actions ecosystem (similar to npm ecosystem group)

findings.issue: All runtime Docker images install wget (~1MB) solely for HEALTHCHECK purposes
findings.impact: Unnecessary dependency in production images. wget could be replaced with Node.js built-in fetch for health checks.
findings.fix: Replace wget HEALTHCHECK with node -e "fetch('http://localhost:PORT/healthz')" or add a tiny Node.js healthcheck script

findings.issue: Dependabot npm ecosystem has no explicit allow or ignore lists - potential noise from low-value dependency updates
findings.impact: Weekly updates may include unnecessary bumps for devDependencies or low-impact packages. Could be tuned for higher signal-to-noise ratio.
findings.fix: Add allow: list scoped to production dependencies, or add ignore: list for specific low-value packages

findings.issue: No thread_metadata table — reply_count, participant_count, last_activity_at, view_count not tracked
findings.impact: Thread list cannot show reply counts, sort by activity, or track participant engagement
findings.fix: Create thread_metadata table: id (PK = message_id), reply_count INT DEFAULT 0, participant_count INT DEFAULT 0, last_activity_at TIMESTAMPTZ, view_count INT DEFAULT 0

findings.issue: Thread panel has no thread participant tracking, no join/leave semantics, no thread unread counts, no participant list
findings.impact: Thread UX is basic — users cannot see who is in a thread or control thread participation
findings.fix: Add thread participants sidebar, join/leave buttons, thread unread badge, participant count display

findings.issue: No thread_participants table — cannot track who has joined/left a thread for notification routing
findings.impact: Thread notifications must go to all workspace members instead of thread participants only
findings.fix: Create thread_participants table: thread_id FK, user_id FK, joined_at, last_read_at TIMESTAMPTZ. Unique (thread_id, user_id)

findings.issue: No thread-specific API endpoints — no get thread participants, join thread, leave thread, get thread unread count
findings.impact: Frontend cannot manage thread participation or display thread-specific state
findings.fix: Add API endpoints: GET /threads/:id, POST /threads/:id/join, POST /threads/:id/leave, GET /threads/:id/unread

findings.issue: No thread-specific realtime events — thread:reply, thread:participant_joined, thread:participant_left
findings.impact: Thread updates not pushed in real-time; clients must poll
findings.fix: Add socket events: thread:reply (with parent context), thread:participant_joined, thread:participant_left

findings.issue: No thread indicator on messages that have threads — no reply count badge, no thread preview
findings.impact: Users cannot see which messages have active threads without clicking each one
findings.fix: Add thread reply count badge, last reply preview text, and click-to-open-thread on message

findings.issue: No thread-specific tests — no E2E for thread creation, reply, join/leave, unread counts, realtime sync
findings.impact: Thread feature will ship without automated regression coverage
findings.fix: Write tests: create thread via reply API, fetch thread participants, join/leave, verify unread counts, verify realtime events

findings.issue: GET /threads/:id/participants and POST /threads/:id/join lack requireChannelAccess middleware, relying solely on RLS for access control
findings.impact: Any authenticated user who can guess a thread_id can enumerate participants or join threads without verifying channel membership.
findings.fix: Add requireChannelAccess middleware to the /threads/:id/participants and /threads/:id/join routes. Threads require resolving the parent message's channel_id first.

findings.issue: Thread panel fetches data once on mount and does not subscribe to WebSocket events for real-time reply updates
findings.impact: When a new reply arrives while the thread panel is open, the user sees stale data until they close and reopen.
findings.fix: Add socket subscription in ThreadPanel for message:new events, filtering by parent_id === parentMessage.id. Insert new replies into the local replies list immediately.

findings.issue: Thread unread counts are only computed on-demand with no real-time push or badge indicator in the message list
findings.impact: Users have no visual indicator that a thread they participated in has new replies.
findings.fix: Emit a 'thread:unread_update' Socket event with {thread_id, count} when a new reply is created. Subscribe in the frontend message list to update per-message unread counts.

findings.issue: Mobile thread panel uses animate-slide-in-right class but no keyframe animation is defined in CSS — panel appears/disappears instantly
findings.impact: The mobile thread transition is jarring rather than smooth.
findings.fix: Define @keyframes slide-in-right and slide-out-right animations in globals.css. Use CSS transition or animation classes with proper timing.

findings.issue: Dark mode CSS only uses @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) but no .dark class selector
findings.impact: ThemeProvider applies .dark class on manual toggle, but CSS never matches it. Manual light/dark selection is completely broken - app always follows OS preference.
findings.fix: Add .dark and :root:not(.light) selectors alongside the media query to support class-based theme switching

findings.issue: Thread replies lack edit, delete, and reaction support
findings.impact: Users cannot edit or delete their thread replies, and cannot react to thread replies. Major UX gap compared to primary message thread.
findings.fix: Add edit/delete actions (same pattern as message-list.tsx) and reaction support to thread panel

findings.issue: No per-user online/offline presence indicators
findings.impact: Users cannot see who is currently online. Only an aggregate 'N online' count is shown in the channel header.
findings.fix: Implement per-user green dot indicators next to user names in message list and member panels

findings.issue: No member list or member management UI in frontend
findings.impact: Users cannot view workspace/channel members, see roles, or invite/remove members from the UI.
findings.fix: Create a members page and member management components

findings.issue: No profile editing beyond avatar upload
findings.impact: Users cannot change display name, status, or bio. Display name is auto-generated from email prefix.
findings.fix: Add profile editing modal/page with display name, status message, and bio fields

findings.issue: Dialog and sidebar-group use raw Unicode icons instead of lucide-react icons
findings.impact: Inconsistent visual style - most of the app uses lucide-react icons, but dialog close is '✕' and sidebar-group chevron is '▸'.
findings.fix: Replace Unicode icons with lucide-react X and ChevronRight components

findings.issue: Message list has no virtualization — all messages rendered as flat DOM, no inverted scroll, no scroll anchoring
findings.impact: Channels with 1000+ messages freeze browser; no scroll anchoring causes position loss on new messages; no scroll-to-load-older
findings.fix: Integrate @tanstack/react-virtual with inverted scroll; implement scroll anchoring and cursor pagination

findings.issue: Workspace layout shows 'Loading...' text instead of skeleton — no visual placeholder for layout structure during auth
findings.impact: First paint shows raw text loading state instead of progressive layout skeleton — poor perceived performance
findings.fix: Replace 'Loading...' with Skeleton components matching workspace layout (sidebar placeholder, header placeholder)

findings.issue: Theme system lacks SSR-safe hydration — flash-of-unstyled-theme (FOUT) on page load
findings.impact: Users see light theme briefly before dark theme applies; jarring visual flash on every navigation
findings.fix: Implement cookie-based theme persistence; inject theme class on server before React hydration; suppress hydration warnings

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut for workspace/channel navigation — users must mouse-click to switch contexts
findings.impact: Power users cannot keyboard-navigate between workspaces or channels; Ctrl+K search is only keyboard path
findings.fix: Add Ctrl+1-9 workspace shortcuts, Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down channel navigation, Ctrl+K global command palette

findings.issue: Message composer is a plain textarea — no markdown preview, no mention autocomplete, no emoji picker, no drag-drop
findings.impact: Message input lacks modern collaboration features; no inline formatting feedback, no @mention discoverability
findings.fix: Implement enhanced textarea with markdown preview toolbar, @mention popover, #channel autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop zone

findings.issue: Thread panel lacks parent message context preview — users see replies without the original message context
findings.impact: Thread viewers must scroll up or remember the parent message; thread context is lost in split-view
findings.fix: Show quoted parent message at top of thread panel with truncated content, timestamp, and author

findings.issue: Search results show flat text excerpts without highlighting matched terms, date range filters, or channel/author filters
findings.impact: Users cannot quickly understand why a result matched; no ability to narrow search by date or channel
findings.fix: Add search term highlighting in results, date range picker, channel filter dropdown, author filter, result type icons (message vs file)

findings.issue: Avatar upload uses instead of Next.js — no lazy loading, no responsive images, no blur placeholder
findings.impact: Avatar images block initial load; no progressive image loading; no fallback animation
findings.fix: Replace with Next.js Image component with lazy loading, blur placeholder, and responsive srcset

findings.issue: Notification dropdown lacks max-height — long notification lists overflow below viewport on small screens
findings.impact: Users with many notifications cannot scroll within the dropdown; notifications extend beyond visible area
findings.fix: Add max-h-96 with overflow-y-auto; show 'Mark all read' at top; add notification type icons (mention, reply, reaction)

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut help overlay — Ctrl+/ or ? should show available keyboard shortcuts
findings.impact: Power users cannot discover keyboard shortcuts; productivity features go unused
findings.fix: Add Ctrl+/ shortcut help dialog listing all keyboard shortcuts with search

findings.issue: Channel list uses Link elements inside role='listbox' without distinguishing aria-labels
findings.impact: Screen reader users cannot distinguish channel navigation items from other list items
findings.fix: Add aria-label='Navigate to channel {channel.name}' on each channel Link; add aria-current='page' for active channel

findings.issue: Message actions (reply, react, edit, delete) hidden on hover only — opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100
findings.impact: On touch devices and keyboard-only navigation, message actions are invisible
findings.fix: Show message actions on focus-within for keyboard users; show permanently on mobile/touch; add touch-friendly larger touch targets

findings.issue: Thread reply input uses fixed rows={2} with no auto-resize — unlike main message input which auto-resizes
findings.impact: Inconsistent composing experience between main chat and threads
findings.fix: Replace fixed rows with auto-resize textarea matching message-input.tsx pattern

findings.issue: No global command palette (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K) — search only available via search bar in sidebar
findings.impact: Users cannot quickly navigate to channels, users, or settings from anywhere via keyboard
findings.fix: Implement Ctrl+K global command palette: search channels, users, settings, recent conversations; keyboard-navigable results

findings.issue: Settings page has no loading skeleton or section navigation — full page reloads on setting change
findings.impact: Settings UX feels sluggish; no progressive loading or section-based navigation
findings.fix: Add settings sidebar navigation with sections (Profile, Preferences, Notifications, Theme); implement Skeleton loading for each section

findings.issue: Theme toggle lacks transition animation — theme change is instantaneous with no gradual color transition
findings.impact: Theme switch is jarring; no smooth visual transition between themes
findings.fix: Add CSS transition on color properties with `transition: color 0.3s, background-color 0.3s` on root elements

findings.issue: No notification sound or visual ping — new messages visually appear but have no audio/visual attention cue
findings.impact: Users may miss messages when not actively looking at the chat pane
findings.fix: Add subtle notification sound for @mentions and direct replies; configurable in preferences

findings.issue: No 'Jump to present' button when scrolled up — users must scroll to bottom manually after reviewing history
findings.impact: Inconvenient to return to latest messages after reading history
findings.fix: Add floating 'Jump to present' button with unread count badge that appears when scrolled up beyond last read

findings.issue: Avatar shows first letter of email as fallback — may display '@' or other invalid characters
findings.impact: Poor visual presentation for users without display names set
findings.fix: Use display_name if available, then email prefix (before @), then '?' as last resort

findings.issue: Notification bell shows unread count but no visual distinction for mention types (@user vs @everyone vs thread reply)
findings.impact: Users cannot prioritize attention based on notification type
findings.fix: Add color-coded indicators: red for @mentions, blue for direct replies, gray for @everyone, neutral for other notifications

findings.issue: No reduced-motion preference detected — animations play regardless of prefers-reduced-motion setting
findings.impact: Users with motion sensitivity get unnecessary animations
findings.fix: Add prefers-reduced-motion media query check and disable non-essential animations

findings.issue: No confirmation dialog for destructive settings actions (delete account, reset preferences)
findings.impact: Users may accidentally delete account or lose custom preferences
findings.fix: Add confirmation dialogs with 'Are you sure?' text for destructive actions; require typing 'DELETE' for account deletion

findings.issue: No comprehensive design token system — color tokens are ad-hoc CSS variables mixed with raw Tailwind values
findings.impact: Inconsistent colors, spacing, and typography across components; theme changes require per-component edits
findings.fix: Define complete token architecture: --color-*, --spacing-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*, --font-*, --opacity-* tokens in globals.css. Replace all raw Tailwind values with token references.

findings.issue: No semantic color system — colors are named by visual property (--color-blue-500) instead of semantic purpose (--color-link-primary)
findings.impact: Theme changes require updating every blue shade rather than just remapping semantic tokens; inconsistent color application
findings.fix: Define semantic color tokens: --color-bg-primary, --color-bg-secondary, --color-text-primary, --color-text-secondary, --color-link, --color-brand, --color-danger, --color-success, --color-warning, --color-border. Map to theme-specific values.

findings.issue: No typography system — text sizing uses ad-hoc Tailwind classes (text-sm, text-base, text-lg, text-2xl, text-3xl) with no design scale
findings.impact: Inconsistent text sizing across pages; no design system guardrails for heading hierarchy
findings.fix: Define typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32/40px with corresponding line-heights. Create Text and Heading components wrapping tailwind-merge for consistent usage.

findings.issue: No density/spacing model — spacing values are scattered as raw Tailwind classes (p-2, p-3, p-4, gap-2, gap-4) with no semantic mapping
findings.impact: Inconsistent component spacing; layout density changes require per-component edits rather than global token adjustment
findings.fix: Define spacing scale: --spacing-xs (4px), --spacing-sm (8px), --spacing-md (16px), --spacing-lg (24px), --spacing-xl (32px). Map to semantic contexts: --spacing-inset, --spacing-stack, --spacing-inline.

findings.issue: Only 2 themes (light/dark) with limited token coverage — no Slate Dark, OLED High-Contrast, or system-level theme inheritance
findings.impact: Theme expansion requires rewriting all tokens; no graceful system-preference fallback
findings.fix: Implement multi-theme architecture: .theme-light, .theme-dark-slate, .theme-dark-oled CSS classes with complete token sets. Add theme inheritance (system -> preferred -> default). SSR-safe hydration.

findings.issue: Primitive components (Button, Input, Dialog) lack state-style coverage — no disabled, error, loading, or focused states for all variants
findings.impact: Components show inconsistent disabled/error/loading visuals; accessibility gaps in state announcement
findings.fix: Add explicit state styles to each primitive: :disabled, :focus-visible, :invalid, [aria-invalid], .loading state with spinner. Use tailwind-merge for composed class names.

findings.issue: No motion system — animations use raw @keyframes with no timing tokens, easing curves, or duration scale
findings.impact: Inconsistent animation durations and easing; no design system for motion
findings.fix: Define motion tokens: --duration-fast (150ms), --duration-normal (250ms), --duration-slow (400ms); --easing-in, --easing-out, --easing-in-out. Apply consistently to transitions and animations.

findings.issue: Background colors use raw opacity values (opacity-50, opacity-70) instead of semantic overlay tokens
findings.impact: Opacity stacking creates unpredictable colors; theme changes break overlay colors
findings.fix: Define overlay tokens: --color-overlay-subtle, --color-overlay-hover, --color-overlay-active with proper alpha values instead of tailwind opacity classes

findings.issue: Button component supports only primary/secondary/ghost variants — no danger, success, or warning semantic variants
findings.impact: Destructive actions use manual danger styling; no consistent semantic button pattern
findings.fix: Add danger (red), success (green), and warning (amber) variants to Button component with proper hover/focus/disabled states

findings.issue: No focus styling token — focus-visible rings use hardcoded classes (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500)
findings.impact: Focus ring color/style changes require per-component edits; inconsistent focus visibility across themes
findings.fix: Define --color-focus-ring token; create .focus-ring utility class; ensure all interactive elements use it

findings.issue: No reduced-motion token — prefers-reduced-motion not checked, animations play unconditionally
findings.impact: Users with motion sensitivity get distracting animations
findings.fix: Add --motion-reduced boolean; wrap non-essential animations in prefers-reduced-motion: reduce @media query

findings.issue: No shadow/elevation token system — box-shadow values are ad-hoc across components
findings.impact: Inconsistent elevation styling; no design system for visual hierarchy
findings.fix: Define shadow scale: --shadow-sm, --shadow-md, --shadow-lg, --shadow-xl, --shadow-dialog

findings.issue: No compact/comfortable/spacious density mode — layout density is fixed
findings.impact: Users cannot adjust information density, especially in message list
findings.fix: Add density CSS variable (--density) with compact/comfortable/spacious values; adjust padding, margins, and font sizes proportionally

findings.issue: No design token documentation — tokens exist only in CSS files with no reference or usage guide
findings.impact: Developers cannot discover available tokens; inconsistent token usage across codebase
findings.fix: Create DESIGN_TOKENS.md documenting all tokens with examples; add token usage lint rule

findings.issue: Dark theme CSS variables only defined inside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) - no .dark class selector
findings.impact: ThemeProvider applies .dark class to <html> on manual toggle, but CSS has no .dark selector. Manual light/dark toggle has zero visual effect.
findings.fix: Duplicate dark theme variables under a .dark selector or restructure to use class-based theming in addition to the media query

findings.issue: --color-accent-primary CSS variable referenced but never defined in any token file or @theme block
findings.impact: Falls through to default browser styling. The callback page may have invisible or incorrectly styled accent elements.
findings.fix: Define --color-accent-primary in semantic-colors.ts and styles.css, or replace with existing --color-brand-primary

findings.issue: Dialog close button uses raw Unicode '✕' instead of lucide-react X icon
findings.impact: Visual inconsistency - toast component uses lucide-react X, but dialog uses Unicode. Icon weight/alignment differs.
findings.fix: Replace with lucide-react X component

findings.issue: globals.css re-declares --font-sans and --font-mono identical to values already in packages/ui/src/styles.css
findings.impact: Unnecessary duplication. If one is updated and the other is not, font rendering becomes inconsistent.
findings.fix: Remove duplicate font declarations from globals.css, rely on styles.css import

findings.issue: Toast component uses inline SVG icons for variant indicators instead of lucide-react icons
findings.impact: Inconsistent with the rest of the app which uses lucide-react throughout. Inline SVGs have different sizing and stroke styles.
findings.fix: Replace inline SVGs with lucide-react CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Info components

findings.issue: Density (comfortable/compact/spacious) and motion token systems defined in JS but never used in any component or CSS
findings.impact: Dead code that adds complexity. Users cannot customize UI density or animation speed as the token system intended.
findings.fix: Either implement density mode switching in the theme provider, wire to CSS variables, or remove unused token groups

findings.issue: [Phase 3] Message list has no virtualization — all messages as flat DOM, no inverted scroll, no scroll anchoring, no cursor pagination
findings.impact: OOM on large channels; scroll position lost on new messages; cannot load older history
findings.fix: Implement virtualization with @tanstack/react-virtual, inverted scroll for chat, scroll anchoring, cursor-based pagination. This is the highest-impact UX improvement.

findings.issue: [Phase 1] No semantic color or typography system — raw Tailwind classes used throughout
findings.impact: Theme changes require hundreds of per-component edits; inconsistent visual language
findings.fix: Implement full design token system: semantic colors, typography scale, spacing scale, motion tokens. Create Text and Heading primitives.

findings.issue: [Phase 2] Workspace layout skeleton missing — 'Loading...' text shown during auth initialization
findings.impact: Poor perceived performance; no progressive layout rendering
findings.fix: Create AppShellSkeleton component matching workspace layout structure with animated pulse placeholders

findings.issue: [Phase 3] Message composer is plain textarea — no rich editing, markdown preview, @mention autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop
findings.impact: Core composing experience lacks modern collaboration features
findings.fix: Phase 3 implementation: enhanced textarea with markdown preview toolbar, @mention popover, #channel autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop zone with upload progress

findings.issue: [Phase 4] Search lacks filters and result highlighting — no date range, channel filter, author filter, term highlighting
findings.impact: Search UX is basic; users cannot narrow results or see why content matched
findings.fix: Add search filters: date picker, channel multi-select, author; add <mark> term highlighting in excerpts; show file vs message type icon

findings.issue: [Phase 5] No tablet-specific breakpoint — layout jumps from 3-column desktop to single-column mobile at 768px
findings.impact: Tablet users get suboptimal layout; no progressive collapse pattern
findings.fix: Add tablet breakpoint (1024px): collapsed sidebar as slide-out drawer, always-visible workspace icons, compact message area

findings.issue: [Phase 6] Theme customization limited to light/dark/system — no Slate Dark, OLED High-Contrast, or user-definable accent colors
findings.impact: Users cannot customize the app appearance beyond basic light/dark toggle
findings.fix: Add Slate Dark and OLED High-Contrast themes; add accent color picker in settings; persist preferences

findings.issue: [Phase 2] No global keyboard command palette (Ctrl+K) for searching channels, users, settings
findings.impact: Navigation requires mouse or sidebar clicking; no quick keyboard access to any page
findings.fix: Implement Ctrl+K command palette with search across channels, users, settings, recent conversations; keyboard navigable

findings.issue: [Phase 3] Message actions (reply, react, edit, delete) hidden on hover only — not keyboard accessible
findings.impact: Touch and keyboard users cannot access message actions
findings.fix: Show actions on group-focus-within; add permanent visibility on mobile/touch devices; increase touch target size

findings.issue: [Phase 4] Settings page has no section navigation or loading skeletons — full page reloads
findings.impact: Settings UX is slow; no visual feedback during section switching
findings.fix: Add settings sidebar with sections (Profile, Notifications, Preferences, Theme, Account); add Skeleton loading per section; implement client-side section switching

findings.issue: [Phase 5] No bottom navigation bar on mobile — users must open sidebar for every context switch
findings.impact: Mobile navigation is slow; requires 2+ taps to switch context
findings.fix: Add mobile bottom tab bar: workspace indicators, channel list access, notifications, search, user menu

findings.issue: [Phase 6] No font size or density preference in user settings — all users get same text size and spacing
findings.impact: Users cannot adjust readability to their preference
findings.fix: Add font size slider (small/medium/large) and density selector (compact/comfortable/spacious) in preferences

findings.issue: [Phase 7] No visual regression testing — Playwright screenshot comparison not configured
findings.impact: UX changes in any phase risk visual regressions without detection
findings.fix: Add Playwright visual snapshot tests for each phase's output: design system, app shell, chat view, settings, mobile breakpoints

findings.issue: [Phase 3] No audio notification for @mentions or direct messages — new messages arrive silently
findings.impact: Users may miss urgent messages when not focused on the chat window
findings.fix: Add configurable notification sounds for @mentions and DMs; respect channel mute preferences

findings.issue: User theme preference (light/dark manual toggle) has no CSS selector - .dark class never matched
findings.impact: Theme toggle cycles modes but has zero visual effect. All theme CSS is inside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) only. Phase 1 (design system foundations) is incomplete.
findings.fix: Add .dark and :root:not(.light) selectors alongside the media query

findings.issue: No member list, invite, or member management UI exists in the frontend
findings.impact: Phase 3 (channel/chat surfaces) and Phase 4 (search/profile/settings) are incomplete. Users cannot discover workspace members or manage access.
findings.fix: Create /members route page with member list, role display, role management, and invite flow

findings.issue: No profile editing for display name, status, or bio - only avatar upload available
findings.impact: Phase 4 (profile surfaces) is incomplete. Display name is auto-derived from email, cannot be changed. User identity is permanently tied to email prefix.
findings.fix: Create profile settings page with editable display name, status message, and bio fields

findings.issue: No route-group-specific not-found.tsx pages for (workspace) or (auth) route groups
findings.impact: Invalid workspace slugs or channel IDs show simple inline text ('Channel not found') instead of proper 404 UX with navigation options. Only root not-found.tsx exists.
findings.fix: Add not-found.tsx to (workspace) and (auth) route groups with relevant navigation links

findings.issue: Settings page only has appearance and notification preferences - no account, profile, workspace, or channel settings
findings.impact: Phase 4 (settings surfaces) is incomplete. Users cannot change password, manage workspaces, configure channel defaults, or manage billing.
findings.fix: Expand settings with account section (profile, password), workspace section (name, slug, avatar), and channel defaults

findings.issue: Ctrl+1-9 workspace switching listed in keyboard shortcut help but not implemented in the handler
findings.impact: Misleading help dialog shows shortcuts that do nothing. Phase 5 (interaction polish) incomplete.
findings.fix: Either implement workspace switching shortcuts or remove them from the help dialog

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts not discoverable - no '?' hint or shortcut icon visible in any UI element
findings.impact: Users may never discover the keyboard shortcut dialog exists. Phase 5 (interaction polish) could improve here.
findings.fix: Add a small '?' button or keyboard icon to the app header or sidebar footer that opens the shortcuts dialog

findings.issue: Reactions re-fetched for all messages on every messages array change
findings.impact: Wasteful network requests when message list updates, causing unnecessary load
findings.fix: Cache reactions per message and only fetch for new message IDs via incremental update

findings.issue: Tablet breakpoint (768-1024px) sidebar auto-collapse not fully tested across all tablet sizes
findings.impact: Tablet users may encounter inconsistent sidebar behavior at edge breakpoints
findings.fix: Verify sidebar collapse/expand behavior across all tablet sizes and orientations

findings.issue: renderPreview uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML with DOMPurify sanitization — acceptable but should be migrated to a safer markdown renderer long-term
findings.impact: Low residual XSS risk if DOMPurify configuration is not comprehensive
findings.fix: Migrate to a dedicated React markdown component (e.g., react-markdown) with proper plugin support

findings.issue: Workflows use pnpm/action-setup@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 caching patterns but no Corepack-based pnpm enablement (visible in reference pattern)
findings.impact: CI workflows may fail if pnpm version is not pinned; no deterministic pnpm version across environments
findings.fix: Add corepack enable and pnpm version pinning to all CI workflows; keep existing setup-node caching

findings.issue: No Vercel deployment workflow exists — frontend is deployed via Docker on DO droplet, not Vercel
findings.impact: Vercel workflow is not applicable; existing Docker-based deployment is correct for current architecture
findings.fix: No action needed — Docker deployment is intentional. Document as architectural decision.

findings.issue: No .github/dependabot.yml exists — reference pattern shows this file in develop snapshot
findings.impact: No automated dependency update monitoring; vulnerability patches require manual tracking
findings.fix: Create .github/dependabot.yml with weekly npm + GitHub Actions ecosystem checks

findings.issue: No Terraform stale lock cleanup logic in workflows — reference pattern shows tfvars file creation from secrets
findings.impact: Terraform apply may fail on stale lock files in multi-worker scenarios
findings.fix: Add stale lock cleanup step (terraform init -lockfile=readonly) before apply in terraform workflows

findings.issue: Husky pre-commit hook exists and works but has deprecation warnings about v10 migration
findings.impact: Pre-commit hook will fail after husky v10 update
findings.fix: Remove deprecated husky .husky.sh reference lines from pre-commit file; prepare for v10 syntax

findings.issue: No instrumentation.ts or Vercel-specific config — reference pattern shows these as differences
findings.impact: These are Vercel-specific files not applicable to Docker deployment. Confirm as intentional skip.
findings.fix: No action needed — document as intentional architectural difference from reference pattern

findings.issue: Reference pattern shows additional migrations (5302034_ticket_comment_editing.sql, 5302035_bootstrap_portal_access.sql) for a different project
findings.impact: These migrations are for the MCT Portal, not the Chat app — confirm they should NOT be adopted
findings.fix: No action needed — document as belonging to separate project. If Chat needs similar features, design new Chat-specific migrations.

findings.issue: Reference pattern uses .mjs config files (eslint.config.mjs, jest.config.mjs) — current repo uses .ts/.js
findings.impact: Cosmetic naming difference; both work. Standardizing is optional.
findings.fix: Defer: adopt .mjs for future config files but do not rename existing ones now

findings.issue: Reference pattern has docs/portal_platform_formal_handoff_bundle/ — our repo has docs/architecture/ and docs/audits/ instead
findings.impact: Different documentation structure — intentional, project-specific organization
findings.fix: No action needed — Chat app has its own documentation structure that should be preserved

findings.issue: No load-testing README exists — reference pattern shows scripts/load-testing/README.md
findings.impact: Load testing documentation gap; k6 scripts exist but undocumented
findings.fix: Add README.md to tests/k6/ explaining how to run load tests and interpret results

findings.issue: No visual regression testing tooling of any kind installed — no Percy, Chromatic, Playwright snapshots, or Applitools
findings.impact: UI regressions reach production undetected — every deploy risks visual breakage with zero automated detection
findings.fix: Install Playwright's built-in visual comparison (await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot()) — no extra dependencies needed

findings.issue: No screenshot baselines for any of the 4 critical screens: login form, workspace main view, channel view, settings page
findings.impact: Visual regression on the most-visited screens goes undetected
findings.fix: Add Playwright visual snapshot tests for login form (desktop + mobile), workspace with sidebar + channel list, and message area

findings.issue: No dark mode visual regression coverage — contrast issues in dark theme go undetected
findings.impact: Dark mode UI can degrade without detection — poor user experience for dark mode users
findings.fix: Add dark mode snapshots for all critical screens by toggling class='dark' on html element before screenshot

findings.issue: No mobile/tablet viewport snapshots — responsive layout regressions undetected
findings.impact: Mobile users may see broken layouts without automated detection
findings.fix: Add Playwright snapshot tests at 375px (mobile) and 768px (tablet) viewport widths for critical screens

findings.issue: No visual diff CI job — screenshot comparison not part of any workflow
findings.impact: Visual regression tests exist (if created) but never execute in CI
findings.fix: Add visual-diff step to E2E CI job with configurable sensitivity threshold (0.1% pixel difference)

findings.issue: No snapshot coverage for empty/loading/error states across any component or page
findings.impact: Edge case UI regressions (empty state, error display, loading skeleton) go undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for: empty workspace list, empty channel list, empty message area, loading skeleton states, 404 page, error display

findings.issue: No snapshot coverage for notification dropdown, thread panel, or file upload preview
findings.impact: Secondary UI surface regressions undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for notification dropdown (populated + empty), thread panel with replies, file upload preview

findings.issue: No Storybook installation — no component development environment for visual testing
findings.impact: Component-level visual testing requires full page renders; no isolated component snapshot capability
findings.fix: Consider adding Storybook for component-level visual regression with Chromatic

findings.issue: No screenshot baseline update mechanism documented
findings.impact: Intentional UI changes require manual baseline replacement — no workflow to approve new baselines
findings.fix: Document baseline update process: CI generates diff report, reviewer approves, new baseline committed

findings.issue: No visual regression testing tool configured — no Percy, Chromatic, Playwright screenshot, or custom snapshot infrastructure
findings.impact: Visual regressions in a complex chat application with multiple themes (light/dark), responsive breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop), and dynamic state (loading/empty/error/online-offline) go completely undetected. A CSS change that breaks message bubble alignment, breaks sidebar responsiveness, or inverts dark mode colors cannot be caught in CI.
findings.fix: Add Playwright screenshot testing with @playwright/test snapshot matchers. Configure dedicated viewport snapshots (375px, 768px, 1280px). Add CI step for visual regression with diff threshold alerts.

findings.issue: 12+ conditional rendering states (empty, loading, error, typing indicator, editing, replying, thread preview, search results, pinned messages, etc.) have no visual snapshot coverage
findings.impact: The message list component has the most complex rendering logic in the app, with 12+ visual states depending on context. Without snapshots, a refactor that breaks the empty state message, misaligns the typing indicator, or corrupts the editing UI will go undetected until a user reports it.
findings.fix: Create snapshot stories/tests for each visual state: (1) empty channel (no messages), (2) loading messages (skeleton), (3) error loading messages, (4) typing indicator visible, (5) message editing UI, (6) thread reply preview, (7) search results mode, (8) pinned message banner.

findings.issue: Sidebar auto-collapse behavior at md breakpoint (768-1024px) has no visual regression test for the three viewport states
findings.impact: The recently implemented responsive sidebar now has three states: expanded sidebar (lg+), auto-collapsed with hamburger (md), and bottom navigation (mobile). Each state renders different navigation elements and layout. Without snapshots at each breakpoint, a CSS or component change that breaks the collapsing behavior or misaligns the hamburger button will not be detected.
findings.fix: Add Playwright viewport snapshots at: (1) 1280px width (desktop — full sidebar), (2) 900px width (tablet — collapsed sidebar with hamburger), (3) 375px width (mobile — bottom nav). Verify sidebar state and hamburger visibility at each breakpoint.
